410a93cd.title: IMG IT Pro Website Architect
410a93cd.description:
As the IMG IT Website Architect for IMG Ford Pro, you will be responsible for defining and driving the strategic architectural vision for our external\-facing website platforms. Reporting to the IMG IT Website Product Manager, you will collaborate closely with cross\-platform product teams, engineering managers, and business stakeholders to design robust, scalable, and secure web solutions.
   

  

 Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will take the initiative to lead technical projects from conception to deployment. You will make high\-level design choices that prioritize manageability, usability, and performance, establishing the optimal architectural approach for website technologies, coding standards, and complex integrations. By leveraging modern architectural paradigms and Micro Frontend (MFE), you will ensure our digital footprint delivers an exceptional, highly performant user experience.
   

  

* Architectural Strategy \& Design: Create high\-level software architecture designs that outline the overall structure, components, and interfaces of the IMG Ford Pro external web presence. Employ modern architectural paradigms and design patterns to create prototypes and optimized solutions.
* Technical Project Leadership: Act as a self\-starter to independently drive architectural initiatives, providing technical guidance to development teams and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with management, IT Product Managers, UX/UI designers, and software engineers to evaluate the feasibility of requirements, determine priorities, and translate business capabilities into technical solution concepts.
* Technology \& Standards Governance: Ensure adherence to established coding standards, development tools, validation processes, and compliance requirements. Provide guidance regarding best practices for web performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG), technical SEO, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Integration \& API Design: Define protocols, APIs, and interfaces that enable seamless communication between the website front\-end and various backend systems, CMS platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager), CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and external third\-party dependencies.
* Platform \& Infrastructure Alignment: Assess feature requirements to determine the most suitable technology stack, integration method, and deployment strategy leveraging major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Documentation \& Artifacts: Develop and maintain Architecture Requirements Documents (ARDs), Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), system context flows, and integration/interface diagrams to support implementation and depict future\-state architecture.
* Technical Debt Management: Identify and manage technical debt across the website portfolio, developing proactive strategies for its reduction and prevention while simplifying complexity.
* Innovation \& Prototyping: Develop prototypes and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to demonstrate new ideas, evaluate emerging web technologies, and illustrate how to apply them within the IMG Ford Pro ecosystem.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with at least 2\-5 years specifically focused on architecture for large\-scale, customer\-facing web platforms.
* Deep expertise in modern web technologies, including React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern build tools.
* Proven experience designing and implementing Micro Frontend (MFE) architectures and MACH architectural principles.
* Strong understanding of Content Management Systems (CMS), specifically Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), and how to architect decoupled or headless front\-end integrations.
* Expertise in API design, RESTful services, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, APIGEE).
* Proven experience designing solutions leveraging modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including static site hosting, CDNs, and serverless functions.
* In\-depth understanding of web performance optimization, web security standards, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* Excellent communication and influential leadership skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and drive alignment across geographically diverse teams.
* Working knowledge of Agile product management methodologies and tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with server\-side rendering (SSR) or static site generation (SSG) approaches.
* Familiarity with architectural frameworks and methodologies (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe).
* Experience delivering external customer solutions with a focus on e\-commerce or commercial automotive/fleet industries.
* Experience architecting solutions that incorporate A/B testing frameworks, customer data platforms (CDPs), and advanced web analytics.

3785b84b.title: Solution Architect
3785b84b.description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

We are looking for a dynamic, creative, and resourceful Solution Architect to join our team at ExxonMobil’s Bengaluru office. This role is ideal for a hands\-on professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You will be responsible for architecture that aligns with organizational goals, scalability, security, and performance standards in ExxonMobil’s Upstream business.

**What you will do**
--------------------

 **Core Responsibilities**

  

* Builds and manages groups of systems and/or integrated solutions within a business or technology capability
* Focuses on solution/product enablement by leveraging existing reference architectures, technology strategies, business capabilities, and gaps to deliver optimal solutions based on intentional prioritization  

Maintains an end\-to\-end view of any connected systems
* Works with other architects/product management roles to define the solution/product direction to meet current and future requirements (strategy and roadmaps)
* Works mostly across conceptual \& logical architecture levels; creates the logical reference architecture diagrams
* Partner with, delivery teams and new initiatives to drive alignment of solutions to reference architectures and strategies (includes guiding technology evaluations and prototype development)
* Engages and influences vendors to identify, learn and socialize emerging product capabilities to meet business needs
* Support technical details required for Procurement and S\&C processes
* Evaluates the existing operating environment to determine effectiveness and suggest changes to meet organizational requirements along with identification of redundant/ineffective systems
* Applies technical expertise to craft feature solutions that abide within the architectural guidelines established by the Enterprise / BDAT Architects
* Ensures enablement work is prioritized for the product
* Serves as technical mentor / leader for program and product teams
* Generally supports multiple delivery teams
* Not expected to take on multiple roles within the organization
* Partners with Product Management roles to identify and prioritize enabler work

 **Other Expectations**

  

* Serves as a technical leader for one IT delivery team
* Expected to be the architect role with the most depth of knowledge for the Solutions within their scope
* Not expected to take on multiple roles within the organization, although it will fill in the System Architect role
* Acts as Cloud Subscription Owner for the systems within their scope, but they may delegate custodianship to a team member
* Architects solutions for MSP's to implement. Validates implementations and the quality of technical outcomes from MSP's
* May take on the Project Lead Architect role for specific projects
* May implement (hands\-on) the foundational architectural components of a technical solution, or PoC them
**About you**
-------------

 **Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum 4 years of hands\-on as Architect.
* Minimum 7 years of overall experinece.
**Your benefits**
-----------------

  

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking \& cross\-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations \& holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

  

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------

  

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit **ExxonMobil India**and **Energy Factor India****.**
* Follow us on**LinkedIn** **and** **Instagram**
* Like us on **Facebook**
* Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability status.

499920f8.title: CloudOps Engineer (L3)
499920f8.description:
**Job Purpose** 




 Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L3\) serves as the Senior technical support for enterprise infrastructure, providing expert\-level administration, troubleshooting, architecture guidance, and technical leadership across complex IT environments. The role is responsible for resolving critical infrastructure issues, driving automation, implementing infrastructure improvements, supporting strategic initiatives, and ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of enterprise platforms.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Architecture \& Engineering** 



* Design, implement, administer, and optimize enterprise infrastructure across Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup, cloud, and GPU platforms.
* Define technical standards, best practices, and operational procedures to improve infrastructure reliability and scalability.



**Advanced Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Lead the resolution of complex and business\-critical infrastructure incidents.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), incident chronology and implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical leadership during Major Incident Management and disaster recovery scenarios.
* Act as the highest escalation point for L1 and L2 support teams.



**Windows \& Active Directory Engineering** 



* Design and administer enterprise Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Certificate Services, Federation Services, and Windows Server environments.
* Lead server lifecycle management, security hardening, patch strategy, and performance optimization.



**Linux Platform Engineering** 



* Administer enterprise Linux platforms, including kernel tuning, automation, clustering, security hardening, high availability, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex OS, application, and platform\-related issues.



**Virtualization \& Container Platform Engineering** 



* Design, administer, and optimize VMware, Hyper\-V, and Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Manage cluster architecture, capacity planning, workload optimization, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.



**Storage, Backup \& Disaster Recovery** 



* Design and administer enterprise storage and backup solutions.
* Lead disaster recovery planning, backup architecture, replication, capacity planning, and business continuity initiatives.



**Cloud Infrastructure** 



* Support Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud infrastructure, hybrid networking, and cloud platform administration.



**GPU \& AI Infrastructure** 



* Design, administer, and optimize GPU infrastructure supporting AI, Machine Learning, and High\-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.
* Manage GPU resource allocation, driver lifecycle, firmware updates, monitoring, and performance optimization.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** 



* Develop infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Drive Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), configuration management, and operational automation initiatives.



**Change, Release \& Capacity Management** 



* Review and implement complex infrastructure changes.
* Lead infrastructure upgrades, migrations, platform refresh, and technology transformation projects.
* Perform capacity planning and infrastructure performance optimization.



**Technical Leadership** 



* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Develop technical standards, runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with architects, engineering teams, OEMs, and vendors on strategic initiatives.



  





**Experience \& Educational Requirement** 




 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
 



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* 6 to 10\+ years in Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering, Managed Services, Data Center Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.
* Proven experience supporting business\-critical production environments with 24×7 operations.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, SCOM, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, ManageEngine, BMC Remedy, or Jira Service Management. Expertise in virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V, Kubernetes, OpenShift), enterprise storage, backup solutions, and hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Strong exposure to GPU infrastructure for AI/ML and HPC workloads, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Ansible), container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise security technologies.

9866c71a.title: Senior Program Manager, Mapping Operations
9866c71a.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states.
   

  

 The Mapping Operations team is responsible for building, validating, and continuously improving the high\-definition maps that power Waymo’s autonomous driving system. The team ensures that the vehicle has an accurate, up\-to\-date understanding of the world by transforming raw sensor data into reliable, production\-ready map assets. The team sits at the intersection of autonomous driving, and scaled operations, partnering closely with Engineering, ML, and Product teams to support safe, scalable deployment across new and existing markets. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager in Hyderabad to lead one of the large Production teams, partner closely with cross\-functional stakeholders \& vendor teams, and help build best\-in\-class operations.
   

  

**You Will**
* Drive operational excellence across the vendor teams, including ensuring SLAs are met, ramping up vendor operations, facilitating business reviews, and resolving day\-to\-day operational issues/ escalations
* Identify process improvement opportunities and implement initiatives to raise the bar on productivity and quality
* Lead strategic initiatives involving tooling, process, and infrastructure that help scale the organization
* Manage large projects from concept to launch by developing realistic project estimates and coordinating with stakeholders including Engineering, Product and Operations
* Monitor, measure and communicate project progress and team performance to program teams, and executive leadership
* Provide mentorship/ managerial support for junior team members


**You Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in technical or business discipline
* Overall 12\+ years of work experience managing large\-scale and dynamic programs
* At least 4 years of direct people management experience
* Experience working with and managing scaled vendor operations teams
* Proven collaboration and communications skills working with globally distributed teams and multiple stakeholders
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data

**Role Overview:**

 **bridge between Sales, Sourcing, and recruitment execution** 
 . This role owns
 **delivery planning, prioritization, capacity allocation, and stakeholder alignment** 
 , ensuring recruitment efforts are focused on the right roles at the right time.
   

  

 RBPs do
 **not execute individual sourcing** 
 , but are accountable for
 **what gets worked on, by whom, and when** 
 , ensuring POD Leads and Recruiters can execute effectively and without ambiguity.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Own recruitment delivery planning for assigned Sales portfolios or accounts.
* Translate Sales demand into clear, actionable delivery plans for PODs.
* Prioritize roles based on revenue impact, urgency, and delivery complexity.
* Continuously rebalance priorities based on pipeline movement and Sales changes.
* Act as the primary recruitment delivery partner to Sales.

* Provide structured updates on delivery progress, risks, and trade\-offs.

* Ensure POD Leads are clear on priorities, success metrics, and timelines.

* Serve as the primary escalation point for recruitment delivery challenges.
* Resolve conflicts related to competing priorities, unrealistic timelines, capacity constraints, and quality or delivery breakdowns.
* Track and review delivery KPIs across assigned PODs.
* Identify trends in time\-to\-hire, pipeline quality, interview\-to\-offer ratios, and drop\-offs and rejections.

**Key Requirements:**
* Strong stakeholder and expectation management skills.
* Ability to translate business priorities into operational plans.
* Data\-driven decision making and comfort with delivery metrics.
* Clear communication, influence, and escalation handling.
* Deep understanding of recruitment dynamics and market behavior.


**Other Details:**
 This position requires collaboration across various teams to ensure clarity of ownership and smooth hand\-offs. It emphasizes the importance of controlled and predictable recruitment scaling, with a focus on maintaining high confidence among stakeholders.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced SAP IBP Solution Architect to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of end\-to\-end Integrated Business Planning solutions. Operating at the intersection of supply chain strategy and technology, you will translate complex business planning requirements into scalable, best\-practice SAP IBP architectures — while guiding clients or internal stakeholders from discovery through go\-live and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Solution Design \& Architecture**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture of SAP IBP implementations across one or more planning domains.
* Define data models, integration patterns, and system landscape for IBP deployments within an SAP S/4HANA or hybrid ecosystem.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution blueprints, including fit\-gap analysis and design decisions.
* Establish best\-practice configuration standards and ensure alignment with SAP's quarterly release roadmap.


**Delivery \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Lead or support full project lifecycle activities: workshops, blueprint, build, testing, hypercare, and handover.
* Engage C\-suite and VP\-level supply chain stakeholders; present architectures, trade\-offs, and recommendations with clarity.
* Mentor and review the work of functional consultants and junior architects on project teams.
* Coordinate with SAP basis, integration, and data engineering teams to ensure end\-to\-end solution integrity.


**Practice Development**
* Contribute to practice assets — accelerators, templates, methodology guides, demo environments.
* Stay current with SAP IBP product direction and bring insights back to the team and clients.


**Required Skills**
**Deep, hands\-on implementation experience is required across all five core areas below.**
**Advanced Demand Planning (Statistical Modelling)**
* Statistical forecasting: model selection (ARIMA, exponential smoothing, causal), MLR, and error metrics.
* Experience tuning forecast models, cleansing historical data, and improving baseline accuracy KPIs.
* Understanding of machine\-learning\-enhanced forecasting options within SAP IBP.


**Response \& Supply (R\&S)**
* Demand\-driven planning, heuristics\-based supply run, multi\-echelon supply network design.
* Hands\-on experience configuring supply network models, planning areas, and key figure hierarchies.


**Optimizer**
* Constraint\-based optimisation using SAP IBP Optimizer (supply, demand, or inventory objectives).
* Familiarity with optimisation model configuration, constraints, objective functions, and KPI design.


**Order\-Based Planning (OBP)**
* Order\-based supply planning: MRP\-like logic, pegging, firming rules, and order handling in IBP.
* Experience with integration touch\-points between OBP and ERP order management.
* Custom dashboards and analytical apps.
* Hands\-on SAP BTP Build Work Zone.
* SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)/Web IDE.
* SAP Gateway and backend integration


**Qualification \& Education**
* 8\+ years in SAP supply chain planning; 4\+ years as Solution Architect
* 5\+ full\-cycle IBP implementations (at least 2 as lead architect)
* Exposure to 2\+ industries (e.g., CPG, retail, pharma, manufacturing)
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field (MBA a plus)
* Ability to present technical architecture to executive audiences
* Proven track record leading cross\-functional, multi\-vendor teams


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
* SAP IBP Business Planning (xP\&A)
* SAP BTP / extension development
* Financial planning integration (BPC / Analytics Cloud)
* Anaplan, O9, Kinaxis or competing tool knowledge
* S\&OP / IBP process design \& facilitation
* SAP certification in IBP or related modules

We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

0bd212c7.title: Service Delivery Manager
0bd212c7.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for establishing, operating, and continuously improving Service Level Management for the assigned SAP and ERP application services. The role ensures reliable service delivery, effective lifecycle management, compliance, security, and ongoing alignment with business requirements.
   

  

 The incumbent will work closely with business stakeholders, internal technology teams, SAP functional teams, infrastructure teams, and external service providers to design sustainable solutions, manage service performance, and drive continuous improvement across the SAP application landscape. The role includes ownership of service governance, vendor performance, service reporting, incident and problem management, application lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**SAP Application and Functional Service Management**
* Manage the end\-to\-end service delivery of SAP applications and related ERP services.
* Work with business stakeholders and SAP functional teams to understand business requirements, service expectations, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure that SAP services are designed, transitioned, operated, and retired in line with established service management processes.
* Coordinate SAP application enhancements, releases, upgrades, maintenance activities, and improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate integration between SAP applications and connected systems, platforms, and business processes.
* Support the successful transition of new or enhanced SAP solutions into production with minimal business disruption.
* Ensure operational readiness, including support documentation, monitoring, knowledge transfer, support models, and formal handover.
* Monitor application availability, performance, capacity, stability, adoption, and user satisfaction.


**Service Level and Performance Management**
* Establish and manage Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements, and related service targets.
* Define meaningful service performance indicators and ensure that agreed KPIs are measured and reported consistently.
* Lead periodic service reviews with business stakeholders, internal teams, and strategic service providers.
* Prepare and deliver service performance reports, management dashboards, annual service reviews, and improvement plans.
* Identify service gaps, agree corrective actions, and track improvement initiatives through to completion.
* Ensure that service\-related information is maintained accurately in relevant repositories and IT service management tools, such as ServiceNow, CMDB, monitoring platforms, and reporting solutions.
* Drive consistent implementation of the service management framework across the assigned SAP service portfolio.


**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**
* Ensure effective management of major incidents, recurring incidents, problems, and service requests.
* Coordinate root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive actions, and post\-incident reviews.
* Track application outages, downtime, service interruptions, and business impact.
* Ensure that changes to SAP applications are assessed, approved, communicated, tested, and implemented in accordance with change management procedures.
* Work with relevant teams to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.
* Support automation and process optimisation opportunities across service management and SAP operations.


**Vendor and Partner Management**
* Manage the operational performance of SAP service providers and strategic partners.
* Review vendor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality targets, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely delivery of service reports, improvement plans, corrective actions, and annual service reviews.
* Facilitate governance meetings and maintain clear escalation and communication paths.
* Ensure that suppliers meet applicable security, quality, compliance, and service management expectations.


**Compliance, Risk, and Business Continuity**
* Ensure that SAP services comply with applicable internal policies and external requirements, including security, vulnerability management, data protection, licensing, GxP, and GDPR obligations, where relevant.
* Support risk identification, mitigation planning, audit readiness, and compliance reporting.
* Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery and business continuity plans for the assigned SAP applications.
* Plan, coordinate, and document Disaster Recovery tests and follow up on identified actions.
* Ensure that service operations support business continuity and minimise disruption to critical business processes.


**SAP Functional Background**
 A good understanding of SAP functional processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with SAP business process owners and functional consultants is required.
   

  

 Experience in
 **two or more of the following SAP functional modules** 
 will be considered an added advantage:
   

  

* SAP FI – Financial Accounting
* SAP CO – Controlling
* SAP MM – Materials Management
* SAP SD – Sales and Distribution
* SAP PP – Production Planning
* SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
* SAP QM – Quality Management
* SAP PS – Project System
* SAP WM / EWM – Warehouse Management / Extended Warehouse Management
* SAP Ariba – Procurement and Supplier Management


**Education And Professional Experience**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in software services, application management, ERP operations, or IT service delivery.
* At least 5 years of experience working in an international or globally distributed environment.
* Experience managing SAP applications, enterprise platforms, or complex business\-critical application services.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders, business teams, technology functions, and external service providers.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience is required.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of IT service management principles, particularly Service Level Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Capacity Management, and Service Continuity Management.
* Practical understanding of SAP application landscapes, functional processes, integrations, and operational dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into sustainable service and application management solutions.
* Strong capability to develop concepts, establish governance models, and drive pragmatic implementation.
* Experience with service performance management, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, CMDBs, monitoring solutions, ticketing systems, and service repositories.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, escalation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of information security, risk management, data protection, quality standards, and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, international, and matrixed environment.
* Proactive approach to automation, standardisation, service improvement, and operational excellence.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

**﻿**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, inquisitive, and highly articulate Lead Program Manager to drive our enterprise portfolio reporting and executive status reviews. In this role, you will serve as the central source of truth for executive leadership, transforming complex, cross\-functional project data into clear, strategic narratives.
   

  

 This is not a passive data\-aggregation role. You will actively collaborate with—and respectfully challenge—peer program managers to dig beneath surface\-level updates, uncover hidden risks, and ensure our executive reporting reflects accurate, objective reality. If you have an eagle eye for risk, exceptional diplomatic persistence, and top\-tier presentation design skills, this role is built for you.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Executive Portfolio Reporting: Design, produce, and iterate weekly, monthly, and quarterly enterprise portfolio reports, executive dashboards, and board\-level presentation decks.
* Status Integrity \& Risk Uncovering: Actively review project updates submitted by program and project managers. Ask probing questions, audit assumptions, and identify unmitigated risks or dependencies to ensure reporting reflects true status rather than optimistic estimations.
* Executive Presentation Design: Translate dense technical, operational, and financial information into highly visual, executive\-ready PowerPoint decks that convey clear metrics, trade\-offs, and decisions required.
* Executive Status Reviews: Plan, facilitate, and lead regular status reviews with executives and senior leaders, driving aligned action on critical enterprise risks and blockers.


**Qualifications**

621683c2.title: Presales Specialist
621683c2.description:
**Company Description** 
 House Construct is a construction company with a legacy of excellence built since 1997\. With over two decades of experience and more than 400 satisfied clients, the company focuses on creating exceptional, high\-quality living spaces. Innovation, precision in design and building, and a commitment to sustainability shape every project. House Construct is known for turning client visions into reality while maintaining the highest standards of construction. Team members join an organization that values craftsmanship, reliability, and long\-term client relationships.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Presales Specialist role based in Bengaluru South. The Presales Specialist will engage prospective clients, understand their requirements, and present tailored construction solutions and project proposals. Daily responsibilities include conducting needs assessments, preparing estimates and technical presentations, coordinating with engineering and project teams, and supporting sales meetings and site visits. The role also involves responding to inquiries, preparing documentation and bid responses, maintaining accurate presales records, and contributing to continuous improvement of presales processes and tools. The Presales Specialist will collaborate closely with sales and customer service teams to ensure a smooth transition from initial inquiry to project onboarding.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret client requirements, assess project feasibility, and support accurate cost and timeline estimations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly, deliver persuasive presentations, and prepare professional proposals and documentation.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Presales skills to conduct needs analysis, recommend suitable solutions, and collaborate with sales teams to close opportunities.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service skills to respond promptly to client queries, manage expectations, and build long\-term, trust\-based relationships.
* Relevant experience in construction, real estate, or related project\-based industries is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru South, conduct client meetings and site visits, and coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with productivity and presentation tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, slide decks); familiarity with CRM systems is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience in presales or technical sales.

b1b570b9.title: Manager II - Pre- Sales Support (RFP/RFQ), Test Architects
b1b570b9.description:

 Job Description \- A leader with 10\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering with progressive roles managing IT quality assurance. Extensive experience in solution development, CXO level customer interactions, excellent proposal preparation, writing and management experience who will manage the proposal process, which includes prioritizing RFPs based on the likelihood of winning and value and prioritizing RFPs based on the likelihood of winning and value. Must have experience in active participation in large deals end to end from solution articulation, pricing and providing defense. Responsibilities
   

  

* Work with leading customers to identify opportunities to enhance value from UST
* Identify and articulate technology solutions that will fit the customer in the most cost effective and optimized manner
* Conduct QE maturity assessments and propose QE transformation roadmaps including technology, people, and process refinements
* Work with alliance partners to proactively identify potential joint opportunities and take them to fruition
* Define GTM opportunities in the QE specialized services space
* Enhance the RFP and proposal response process to improve win rates.
* Consult with the sales team on opportunities \& disseminate content to SME for completion.
* Comply with department, team and project proceses and identify innovative ways of improving efficiency of the proposal process.
* Review quotation orders and resolve order acceptance issues.
* Gather information on selling strategy, pricing, engineering.
* Work with Proposals Lead and be responsible for updating RFP response software services.
* Collect customer documentation and evaluate bid requests and specifications. Skills

* Excellent presentation and communications skills
* Experience in conducting market \& competitor research

e1f21e0e.title: Solutions Architect (Lakebase)
e1f21e0e.description:
FEQ327R245
   

  

**Mission**
 The
 **Solutions Architect (Lakebase)** 
 team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go\-to\-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position
 *in\-depth* 
 the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.
   

  

 The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product\-line in a meaningful way.
   

  

**The Lakebase Product\-line Requires The Following Core Technical Competencies**
* 10\+ years of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre\-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client\-facing solutions.
* Credibility in influencing OLTP products with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate transactional data systems within broader Big Data, Lakehouse, and AI ecosystems.
* Infrastructure, platform and administration expertise around disaster recovery, high availability, backup and recovery, scale\-out methods, identity and security management, migrations (vendor\-to\-vendor, on\-prem to cloud)


**The impact you will have**
* Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high\-impact engagement strategies across your territory.
* As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.
* Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer\-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.
* Influence product roadmap by translating field\-derived, data\-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams
* Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier\-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission\-critical environments.


**Competencies \& Responsibilities**
* 6\+ years in a customer\-facing, pre\-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high\-level data strategy and product adoption.
* Proven ability to co\-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross\-functional effort across GTM and R\&D teams.
* Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third\-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.
* Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem\-solving using SQL and Python.
* Hands\-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, AI, ML, governance, transactional systems, app development, and streaming.
* Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.
* A track record of driving complex projects to completion in fast\-paced, customer\-facing environments.

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

1d19934e.description:
**Job Summary**

DB Plus is looking for an Architect with 2\+ years of relevant professional experience to join our team in Madurai. The role will involve architectural design, planning, working drawings, detailing, consultant coordination, presentations, material selection, documentation and project involvement through different stages of design and execution.

* Strong architectural design and planning skills
* Good working\-drawing and detailing knowledge
* Understanding of construction methods and materials
* Ability to read and coordinate architectural and consultant drawings
* Good presentation and documentation skills
* Strong communication and coordination abilities
* Attention to detail and problem\-solving ability
* Proficiency in relevant architectural and design software

**Preferred**

Experience in healthcare, institutional, commercial or large\-scale projects will be considered an added advantage.

Apply through Indeed or send your CV and portfolio to:**dbplusarchitect@gmail.com**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹27,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* What is your notice period ?
* What is your current monthly salary?

Experience:

* more than: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

d77aecf1.title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
d77aecf1.description:
**About Pearson** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
 **Add life to a lifetime of learning.** 



  

  


 As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI\-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital\-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher\-value work while accelerating business transformation.
 


  

  


 The
 **Office of the CTO** 
 powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital \& Technology (D\&T), the
 **AgentOps Team** 
 leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.
 


  

  


**Why Join AgentOps?** 



  

  


 This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.
 


  

  


 You will:
 


  

  
* Build cutting\-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  

  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  

  
* Solve high\-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  

  
* Influence enterprise\-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  

  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  


  


**Role Overview** 



  

  


 The
 **Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations** 
 is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end\-to\-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise\-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.
 


  

  


 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.
 


  

  


 As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI\-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.
 


  

  


 You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI\-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  


**Business Analysis \& Opportunity Discovery** 



  

  
* Lead end\-to\-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  

  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI\-driven workflow transformation.
  

  
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  

  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  

  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  

  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  


  


**Solution Design \& Agentic Architecture** 



  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi\-agent systems, and semi\-autonomous business processes.
  

  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
  

  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  

  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  

  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  

  
* User Journeys
  

  
* Process Flows
  

  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  

  
* Agent Behavior Models
  

  
* Data \& Integration Specifications
  

  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  

  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  


  


**Agentic AI \& Automation Delivery** 



  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  

  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  

  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  

  
* Autonomous and semi\-autonomous agents
  

  
* Human review and approval stages
  

  
* Escalation paths
  

  
* Exception handling
  

  
* Feedback loops
  

  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  

  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  

  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  


  


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership** 



  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  

  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  

  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  

  
* Facilitate decision\-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  

  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  


  


**Responsible AI, Governance \& Risk Management** 



  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  

  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  

  
* Hallucination risks
  

  
* Prompt injection attacks
  

  
* Data leakage
  

  
* Model misuse
  

  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  

  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high\-stakes use cases.
  

  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  

  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  


  


**Delivery Excellence \& Business Impact** 



  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  

  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  

  
* Productivity improvements
  

  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  

  
* Time savings
  

  
* Automation utilization
  

  
* Employee experience improvements
  

  
* Customer experience outcomes
  

  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  

  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  


  


**Innovation \& Capability Building** 



  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  

  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  

  
* Prompt libraries
  

  
* Agent templates
  

  
* Automation accelerators
  

  
* Design standards
  

  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  

  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  

  
* Champion an agentic\-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  


  


**Technology Ecosystem** 



  

  


**Agentic AI \& Large Language Models** 



  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  

  
* OpenAI APIs
  

  
* Claude
  

  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  

  
* Multi\-Agent Frameworks
  


  


**Automation \& Orchestration** 



  

  
* UiPath Studio
  

  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  

  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  

  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  

  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  


  


**Data, Integration \& Enterprise Platforms** 



  

  
* REST APIs
  

  
* JSON / XML
  

  
* OAuth
  

  
* Salesforce
  

  
* ServiceNow
  

  
* Oracle
  

  
* BigQuery
  

  
* OCR \& Intelligent Document Processing
  


  


**Engineering \& Development** 



  

  
* Python
  

  
* JavaScript
  

  
* SQL
  

  
* Git \& Version Control
  

  
* AI\-Assisted Development Tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  


  


**Required Qualifications** 



  

  


**Education** 



  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  

  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  


  


**Experience** 



  

  
* 8\+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  

  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  

  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  

  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  


  


**Technical \& Functional Expertise** 



  

  


 Deep understanding of:
 


  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  

  
* Intelligent process automation
  

  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  

  
* Human\-in\-the\-loop workflow design
  

  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  

  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  

  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  

  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  


  


**Leadership Competencies** 



  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  

  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  

  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  

  
* Executive presence and influence
  

  
* Decision\-making under ambiguity
  

  
* Collaboration across global and cross\-functional teams
  

  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  


  


**Success Measures** 



  

  


 Success in this role will be measured by:
 


  

  
* Enterprise adoption of agentic automation solutions
  

  
* Measurable productivity and efficiency gains
  

  
* ROI realization from automation investments
  

  
* Delivery quality and stakeholder satisfaction
  

  
* Reusability and scalability of solutions
  

  
* Compliance with Responsible AI and governance standards
  

  
* Contribution to Pearson's AI and automation transformation agenda
  


  


**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.** 



  

  


**Join us in building the future of work, where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to create extraordinary outcomes.** 



  

  


**Who we are:** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.
 


  

  


 Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 


  

  


 If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

 Service Owner

 TECHNOLOGY

 Monitor platform health — org limits, technical debt, performance — and proactively recommend remediation as the org scales.

 Support go\-live, hypercare, and post\-implementation enhancements across migrating brands, working within the 5x pod delivery model.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

 7\+ years of Salesforce experience, including significant time in an architect\-level role spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

 Proven experience designing and governing a shared, multi\-org or multi\-brand Salesforce data model at enterprise scale.

 Strong grounding in Salesforce security architecture (roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, territory management) in a multi\-tenant\-style environment.

 Exposure to AI powered development, Generative AI, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.

 Hands\-on experience with declarative and programmatic customization (Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components) and knowing when each is the right tool.

 Experience architecting integrations across a broader Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, CPQ/Revenue Cloud) and external systems such as ERP/NetSuite.

 Experience leading data migration and consolidation efforts, including large\-scale data cleansing, deduplication, and cutover planning.

 Familiarity with Agentforce and Einstein, and an interest in applying AI\-driven capabilities within the CRM.

 Comfortable operating within a multi\-brand, multi\-pod delivery model and collaborating across distributed, cross\-functional teams.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical architecture for executive and non\-technical audiences.

5acd0887.title: Technical Architect – IoT, Cloud & AI ⭐
5acd0887.description:
**Location:** 
 Chandigarh Tricity \| Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



**Experience:** 
 8\+ years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹30–35 LPA \+ meaningful ESOPs
 



  






 If you have recently scaled production systems and are excited by the opportunity to own architecture across the full technology stack at a growing deep\-tech company, this might interest you.
 




  





 And, Chandigarh Tricity offers better AQI, lower living costs, calmer lifestyle, deeper focus :)
 



  




 About Wattr.ai
 
 Wattr.ai is a mission\-driven deep\-tech cleantech company building technology for real\-world challenges across
 **water, agriculture and power infrastructure** 
 .
 



  





 Our technology is being deployed across India, connecting IoT devices, sensors, cloud systems, data platforms, AI/ML and applications.
 



  





 We are a
 **scaling startup** 
 , and technology will be a critical competitive advantage as we grow. We are looking for a Technical Architect who can build the architecture and engineering foundation for this next stage.
 



  




 About the Role
 
 As
 **Technical Architect** 
 , you will own the
 **end\-to\-end technical blueprint of our platform** 
 — from edge devices and sensor ingestion, through cloud infrastructure and data pipelines, to AI/ML services and the web/mobile applications customers interact with.
 



  





 You will
 **set the architectural direction** 
 , make major technology bets, write production code when it matters, review designs, mentor senior engineers and work closely with the founders on
 **product and platform strategy** 
 .
 



  





 This is a
 **hands\-on architect role** 
 , not a purely managerial or documentation\-focused position.
 



**Recent experience scaling production systems is highly preferred.** 
 We are particularly interested in someone who has recently taken systems through significant growth in scale, complexity, users, devices or data volume and understands the architectural challenges that come with scaling.
 



  




 What You’ll Own
 
**End\-to\-end \& enterprise architecture** 



* Own architecture across
 **IoT/sensors/controllers → ingestion → cloud/backend → data pipelines → AI/ML → web/mobile applications** 
 .
* Define and evolve service boundaries, data contracts, event flows, storage choices and deployment topology across
 **cloud and on\-prem environments** 
 .
* Design APIs and integration contracts across device, web and mobile surfaces.
* Maintain a clear enterprise\-level view of how systems, services and technology components fit together.



  





**Scalability, reliability \& distributed systems** 



* Design distributed and event\-driven systems with practical consideration of
 **consistency, availability, latency, fault tolerance and back\-pressure** 
 .
* Own non\-functional requirements including
 **scalability, reliability, latency, security and cost** 
 , with clear SLOs and a roadmap to achieve them.
* Design systems that can scale significantly as deployments, devices, data and customers grow.



  





**Cloud, infrastructure \& production engineering** 



* Define and evolve architecture across
 **AWS, GCP or Azure** 
 .
* Drive modern infrastructure practices including
 **Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes/container orchestration, Docker, CI/CD, observability and SRE practices** 
 .
* Establish standards for production readiness, monitoring, testing, security and release management.



  





**Data, streaming \& analytical systems** 



* Architect data\-intensive systems involving
 **high\-volume ingestion, time\-series data, stream processing, data lakes/warehouses and analytical workloads** 
 .
* Work with technologies such as
 **Kafka, Kinesis and MQTT\-based pipelines** 
 and select appropriate data platforms based on scale and requirements.
* Make sound technology choices across
 **languages, frameworks, databases, message brokers, ML stacks and IoT protocols** 
 , based on technical requirements and long\-term trade\-offs.



  





**IoT, edge \& field realities** 



* Design for real\-world constraints including
 **intermittent connectivity, low\-power devices and noisy sensor data** 
 .
* Evaluate and architect appropriate IoT protocols and platforms such as
 **MQTT, LwM2M, OPC UA, LoRaWAN, NB\-IoT, AWS IoT and Azure IoT Hub** 
 .
* Ensure reliable end\-to\-end operation across edge, device, network and cloud systems.



  





**AI/ML architecture** 



* Architect the integration of
 **AI/ML platforms and services** 
 into the broader product and data architecture.
* Evaluate opportunities involving
 **edge AI, on\-device ML, model deployment pipelines and MLOps at scale** 
 .



  





**Technical leadership \& engineering standards** 



* Establish and raise standards for
 **architecture, code quality, testing, observability, security and release management** 
 .
* Lead design reviews, write clear
 **RFCs/technical designs** 
 , and document the trade\-offs behind major architectural decisions.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the team.
* Translate ambiguous product goals into clear, practical and buildable technical plans.



  





**Cross\-functional \& external technical engagement** 



* Partner with
 **product, hardware and data science teams** 
 to ship features end\-to\-end and de\-risk complex cross\-stack initiatives.
* Participate in technical discovery, integration and deployment discussions with
 **customers, integrators and government/utility partners** 
 .
* Evaluate
 **build\-vs\-buy** 
 decisions and manage key technology partnerships and vendors.



  




 What We’re Looking For
 
**Must\-have** 



* **5\+ years** 
 designing and shipping production software systems, with experience as a Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer or equivalent.
* Strong practical understanding of
 **distributed systems, event\-driven architecture and enterprise architecture** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience
 **scaling production systems** 
 , preferably in a recent role.
* Deep hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform:
 **AWS, GCP or Azure** 
 .
* Strong infrastructure experience including
 **IaC, Kubernetes or equivalent, Docker, CI/CD, observability and SRE** 
 .
* Hands\-on proficiency in
 **at least two** 
 of: Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript/Node.js, C/C\+\+ or Rust.
* Experience designing
 **data\-intensive systems** 
 , including time\-series ingestion, streaming, data pipelines, data lakes/warehouses and analytical workloads.
* Strong API design and system integration experience.
* Ability to make architecture decisions considering
 **scale, reliability, latency, security and cost** 
 , with clear technical trade\-offs.
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to write a clean RFC, explain architecture clearly and run effective design reviews.
* Comfortable remaining
 **hands\-on technically** 
 while providing architectural direction to the team.



**Strong Plus** 
 \- Experience in one or more of:
 


* **IoT, industrial automation, edge computing or connected devices**
* MQTT, LwM2M, OPC UA, LoRaWAN, NB\-IoT, AWS IoT or Azure IoT Hub
* **SCADA, telemetry or control systems**
* Edge AI, on\-device ML, model deployment or MLOps
* **Water, agriculture, energy, power, infrastructure or cleantech**
* Early\-stage or scaling startups
* Taking products/systems from
 **0→1 and subsequently scaling them**
* Real\-world field deployments and unreliable connectivity environments


 How You Work
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Defaults to
 **clarity** 
 in writing, architecture, diagrams and conversations.
* Can
 **make decisions with incomplete information and revisit them when the data changes** 
 .
* Thinks beyond whether something works today to whether it will
 **still make sense at 10x or 100x scale** 
 .
* Balances engineering quality with speed and business reality.
* Can move comfortably between detailed technical implementation and broader product/business strategy.
* Is comfortable going from a
 **Kubernetes manifest to a board\-level discussion** 
 when required.
* Cares about the long\-term craft of the system, not just getting it shipped.
* Raises the technical bar for everyone around them.


 What Success Looks Like
 * A clear, scalable technical architecture is established across
 **edge, cloud, data, AI/ML and applications** 
 .
* The platform can reliably scale as devices, deployments, data and customers grow.
* Architectural bottlenecks and reliability risks are identified
 **before they become production problems** 
 .
* Engineering teams follow strong standards for architecture, testing, security, observability and releases.
* Major technology decisions are deliberate, documented and aligned with product and business requirements.
* Complex cross\-stack initiatives move from ambiguity to production efficiently.
* The architecture evolves into a
 **competitive advantage as Wattr.ai scales** 
 .


 Why Join Wattr.ai?
 * **Own the technical blueprint** 
 of a real\-world deep\-tech platform.
* Join at a critical
 **scaling stage** 
 , where architecture decisions will directly shape the company's next phase.
* Work closely with the
 **founders and senior engineering team** 
 on product and platform strategy.
* Solve technically complex problems across
 **IoT, distributed systems, data, AI/ML and cloud** 
 .
* Work with technology deployed across
 **water, agriculture and infrastructure projects in India** 
 .
* Senior, high\-ownership role with
 **meaningful ESOP upside** 
 .
* Small, high\-trust team with a short distance between a technical decision and its real\-world implementation.

**Join our Team**

You'll own the complete architecture journey—from strategy through production deployment—working across technical and business teams to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to navigate complex organizational landscapes and emerging technology trends.

* Evaluate and recommend large language models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks based on performance, cost, compliance, and security requirements

* Demonstrated commitment to responsible AI, including governance and ethical considerations
* Bonus: Experience scaling AI solutions in telecom or similar complex enterprise environments

* Serve as a key technical point of contact for senior stakeholders, providing clear status reporting (risks/issues, progress updates, escalations, etc.)
* Coordinate effectively across DG Platform, DG Capability teams, Legal Privacy, Compliance, IT/InfoSec, Data Product teams, and vendor partners to drive timely delivery.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications \& Requirements
   

  

* 10\+ years of overall experience
* Experience in data privacy related role in complex global organization.
* Hands\-on Securiti.ai experience is required, including configuration and delivery of at least several core modules (Consent mgt, PIAs, ROPA, DSR, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise implementations involving workflow automation, systems integrations, and production operations.

6c23c60f.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Cloud ML Engineer (AWS) within Data \& Analytics GSL to use ML/AI expertise alongside strong programming and software engineering skills to make machine learning models and analyses easier to use and access. The role supports local markets and group functions to obtain business value from machine learning, and focuses on designing ML systems, productionising prototypes, enabling robust data flows, and evolving Big Data capabilities through reusable assets and patterns.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Design and develop machine learning systems and implementation patterns.

* Productionise data science prototypes and develop machine learning applications aligned to data science requirements.
* Facilitate the flow of data between ML/AI models and the organisation’s data systems.
* Enhance data pipelines to ensure data is clean, accurate, and optimised for machine learning models.
* Partner with the architecture team to evolve Big Data platform capabilities (reusable assets/patterns) and components to meet business requirements and objectives.
* Research, investigate, and evaluate new technologies and methods to improve delivery and sustainability of machine learning applications and services.
* Contribute to defining best practice for agile development of applications running on the Big Data platform.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experience managing the development lifecycle for agile software development projects (Kanban or Scrum exposure).
* Robust data modelling and data architecture skills.
* Knowledge of Big Data frameworks such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Yarn, and Airflow.
* Experience with distributed ML frameworks (for example H2O and/or TensorFlow) and various ML libraries.
* Proven experience creating and deploying end\-to\-end ML pipelines in production, including MLOps.
* Programming experience in **Java** and **Python**.
* Experience with containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes) or cloud alternatives is advantageous.
* **Mandatory** working experience with AWS services including: **SageMaker Pipelines, SageMaker Studio, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, SNS, EventBridge, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeCommit**.
* Experience with other distributed technologies, NoSQL databases, and streaming technologies is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills.
* Must have technical / professional qualifications:
* + 3\-year IT or IS degree or diploma (or related field) is essential; an advanced degree in Computer Science/Math/Statistics (or related discipline) is an advantage.
	+ Relevant cloud certification at professional or associate level.
	+ 5\+ years of relevant experience as an AI/ML Engineer.
	+ 5\+ years of BI or related software development experience.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunities to deliver business value by enabling scalable ML capabilities for local markets and group functions.
* The chance to work on production\-grade ML systems, end\-to\-end pipelines, and MLOps practices on AWS.
* Collaboration with architecture teams to shape reusable Big Data platform assets and engineering patterns.
* Scope to explore and evaluate new technologies and methods to improve sustainability and delivery of ML applications and services.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Strengthening best practices for productionising data science prototypes into reliable ML applications.
* Deepening hands\-on expertise in AWS\-native MLOps and pipeline automation (including SageMaker and AWS developer tools).
* Enhancing Big Data platform design skills through reusable patterns, components, and data pipeline optimisation.

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
