3694575b.title: Specialist, IT Solutions
3694575b.description:
Req ID: 137066
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

 Detailed Description
   

  

* API Design and Development (Architecture \& Specs)


 Design \& Modelling: Design enterprise\-level RESTful and SOAP APIs using OpenAPI specifications (Swagger) and RAML, ensuring strict adherence to microservices architecture principles.
   

  

**Implementation:** 
 Build, configure, and publish complex APIs and loopback applications within the IBM API Connect ecosystem.
   

  

**Custom Policies:** 
 Develop advanced custom policies and gateways utilizing DataPower Extension routing, User\-Defined Policies (UDP), and custom JavaScript/GatewayScript.
   

  

* Integration \& Gateway Management (IBM DataPower)


**Gateway Configuration:** 
 Configure and maintain IBM DataPower Gateways (IDG) to handle traffic routing, throttling, message transformation (XSLT, JSON\-to\-XML), and payload validation.
   

  

**Backend Orchestration:** 
 Integrate APIs seamlessly with back\-end enterprise systems including Databases (SQL/NoSQL), and legacy SOAP web services.
   

  

* API Security \& Governance


**Security Enforcement:** 
 Implement robust API security policies including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, Mutual TLS (mTLS), SAML, and custom client authentication certificates.
   

  

**Governance \& Lifecycle:** 
 Manage the end\-to\-end API lifecycle (Drafting, Publishing, Deprecating, and Retiring) and enforce API product management principles, including rate limiting and monetization plans.
   

  

* DevOps, Deployment \& Operations


**CI/CD Automation:** 
 Build and optimize continuous integration and deployment pipelines for APIC artifacts using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, and APIC toolkits/CLI.
   

  

**Cloud Architecture:** 
 Deploy and manage APIC instances deployed on containerized environments (Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, Cloud Pak for Integration) or public cloud infra (AWS/Azure).
   

  

**Monitoring \& Analytics:** 
 Configure APIC Developer Portals and Analytics to monitor API performance, error tracking, usage metrics, and optimize payload caching.
   

  

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

**Must\-Have Technical Skills**
**Primary Tooling:**
* Minimum 4\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience specifically working with IBM API Connect (including migrating or working with V10\) and IBM DataPower Gateways.
* Security Protocols: Mastery of API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, SSL, WS\-Security).
* Coding \& Transformation: Proficient in GatewayScript, JavaScript, XSLT, XPath, and XML/JSON transformations.
* API Specs: High proficiency in writing clean OpenAPI 2\.0/3\.0 (YAML/JSON) specifications.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of REST, SOAP, HTTP/S, WebSockets, JMS.


**Nice\-to\-Have / Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with alternative API management tools (SAP PO, SAP CPI) for hybrid environments.
* Relevant IBM Certifications (e.g., IBM Certified Solution Developer \- API Connect).


**Soft Skill \& Leadership Requirements**
* Problem\-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot highly complex architectural, connectivity, and performance issues across distributed networks.
* Mentorship: Experience acting as a project Tech Lead, reviewing code for junior developers, and setting development standards.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical integration concepts to non\-technical stakeholders or product managers.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 5 to 10 years; Experience in similar roles


 Typical Education
   

  

* Bachelor Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational Requirements may vary by Geography


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
   

  

 At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high\-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.
   

  

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
   

  

**ATS:** 
 This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high\-reliability markets such as Industrial \& Smart Energy, Aerospace \& Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.
   

  

**CCS:** 
 This segment focuses on high\-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI\-driven growth.
   

  

 Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast\-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.
   

  

 Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
   

  

 Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

165232dd.title: Cloud Application Support Engineer (APAC) - Noida
165232dd.description:
**Our Context**
 NeoXam is a growing international financial software company headquartered in Paris, with a strong and expanding presence across India. Through our combined expertise and transparent approach, we help Buy\-Side and Sell\-Side organizations \- across banking, asset management, and insurance \- navigate the continuous changes shaping the financial industry. Our solutions span the complete financial value chain, from centralized data management to front\- and back\-office software.
   

  

 With 750\+ dedicated staff across 21 offices worldwide \- including Sydney, Melbourne, New York, Boston, Paris, Frankfurt, Luxembourg, Zurich, Geneva, Milan, London, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, Noida, Chennai, and more \- NeoXam combines global scale with an entrepreneurial, collaborative culture. More than 150 clients across the globe trust NeoXam to run their most critical workflows.
   

  

 As part of our expanding NeoXam as a Service (NXaaS) operating model, we are looking for a motivated and technically strong
 **Technical Support \& Cloud Consultant** 
 to join our Indian team. This is a hands\-on role that blends client\-facing support with cloud infrastructure ownership, making it ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of financial software and modern cloud operations. As we continue to grow our global SaaS footprint, this role will evolve alongside increasing monitoring, observability, and operational responsibilities. NXaaS operates a follow\-the\-sun support model across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas \- this role covers Indian business hours.
   

  

 You will support NeoXam's core product suite, including:
   

  

* NeoXam DataHub – a centralized data management platform purpose\-built for financial institutions, serving as a hub for all data consumed or produced across the enterprise.
* NeoXam IBOR – a uniquely independent and flexible Investment Book of Record, providing asset managers with a single, continuously updated source for positions, valuations, and forecasts across multiple views.
* NeoXam Aro – an intelligent, low\-code reconciliation and data lifecycle platform that transforms fragmented, manual processes into a unified, AI\-powered solution.
* NeoXam Impress – an end\-to\-end solution for client, digital, and regulatory reporting, covering data integration, performance calculations, production workflows, and data visualization.


**Your Missions**
 Serve as the first technical point of contact for NeoXam's global clients, covering Australian business hours within NeoXam's follow\-the\-sun support model and ensuring seamless handoff with APAC and EMEA counterparts.
   

  

* Triage, analyze, and own support tickets end\-to\-end \- from anomaly identification and root cause investigation through to resolution, including software\-level fixes in Java and escalation to R\&D when required.
* Review and respond to monitoring alerts and operational dashboards, identifying and acting on anomalies before they impact clients; monitor and manage cloud resources (primarily AWS) to ensure performance and availability against production SLAs.
* Troubleshoot and enhance cloud\-based deployments; implement patches and configuration fixes; support data migration and cloud onboarding initiatives in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
* Manage technical installations, upgrades, and environment refreshes for client\-facing deployments; maintain internal environment replicas for issue reproduction and testing.
* Collaborate with the Paris R\&D team and global support counterparts to resolve complex issues and contribute to the NXaaS knowledge base.
* Support pre\-sales and implementation teams on technical matters; participate in client calls, project updates, and cross\-team coordination.


**Your Profile**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of experience in technical support, implementation, or infrastructure roles within financial software or the banking/financial services industry.
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM); AWS certification is a plus.
* Proficient in Java application troubleshooting \- log analysis, memory management, thread dumps, and configuration.
* Ability to diagnose and interpret common database performance issues \- including slow queries, missing indexes, lock contention, and execution plan analysis. Experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL query tuning is strongly preferred.
* Experience with relational databases \- Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
* Scripting ability (Shell, Python, or equivalent) for automation and diagnostics.
* Familiarity with web application servers (Tomcat, JBoss, or WebSphere) and messaging systems (IBM MQ, Kafka, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of XML, REST/SOAP web services, and API integrations.
* EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service): Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience with Amazon EKS for container orchestration from support perspective.
* Monitoring \& Observability Tools: Hands\-on experience with solutions such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar platforms for system monitoring, logging, and performance visualization.
* Familiarity with Git and standard version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux/Unix environments and command\-line operations.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and ITIL support practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage client relationships professionally and independently.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and collaborative — comfortable working across time zones with global teams.


**Why NeoXam**
 At NeoXam, we love people who are curious, involved, and self\-driven. We encourage creativity and strive to promote an environment and culture based on personal growth and development. We want you to express your full potential and become a major contributor to our continued growth across India and beyond.

7383dfa5.description:
Your IT Future, Delivered.
   

  

 Principal IT Solution Consultant \- Planon
   

  

 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our offices have earned \#GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
   

  

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
 At IT Services, we are passionate about Planon’s Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS). Our Product Management team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of Planon Expert proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.
   

  

*\#DHL \#DHLITServices \#GreatPlace* 
*\#Planon*
**Grow together.**
 Timely delivery of DHL packages around the globe in a way that ensures customer data are secure is in the core of what we do. You will provide second/third level day\-to\-day operation support, and help investigate and resolve incidents, which were not resolved in lower support levels. Sometimes, issues might get tricky and this is where cooperation on troubleshooting with other IT support teams and specialists will come into play. When it comes to firmware bugs, vulnerabilities and other issues related to our technologies, communicating with our vendors is key.
   

  

 For any issues related to telecommunication/security systems within the DHL Group environment, you are our superhero. The same applies when it comes to managing, proposing and implementing all necessary changes to production security devices in all IT Services Data Centers and premises, providing global availability to key DHL Group services.
   

  

 Last but not least, security technologies associated with Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs, Proxies, Azure and Google Cloud are all in your support league.
   

  

**Grow together – Suggestion as part of Global Planon Specific**
 As part of the Global Planon Team, you will play a key role in keeping our worldwide Planon environment running smoothly while driving continuous improvements across the platform.
   

  

  

* Consult and deliver changes in our global Planon syste, partnering with business and IT stakeholders to design, implement, and document stable, scalable, and high\-quality solutions.
* Ensure reliable day\-to\-day operations by supporting and troubleshooting the Planon platform, resolving incidents, and maintaining system stability for our global user community.
* Enable and guide key users by providing functional support, sharing best practices, and helping them fully understand and leverage the capabilities of the Planon system.
* Implement and monitor interfaces to other systems
* Collaborate in an international environment, working closely with colleagues, business partners, and service providers to continuously improve processes and user experience across DHL's Corporate Real Estate ecosystem.


**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**
 As a Planon Expert, having strong FM/real‑estate domain knowledge, and solid technical skills (SQL, Java/JavaScript, APIs), with Planon’s own implementation/functional certifications strongly preferred is a huge plus.
   

  

**About The Role**
* As our global Planon environment grows in scale and complexity, we are strengthening our internal development capabilities. We are therefore looking for both experienced Planon Experts and motivated professionals ready to grow into an expert role.
* You will consult on and implement changes within our worldwide Planon system, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to deliver stable, scalable, and well\-documented solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as lead consultant for complex Planon implementations and changes. especially with the Facility Management area of Planon
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable end\-to\-end Planon solutions.
* Design and implement advanced Planon configurations, business rules, JavaScript and Java (TMS) extensions.
* Define technical solution designs and guide less experienced colleagues.
* Implement complex Planon Gadgets, PSS Forms, TSIs, including JavaScript and SQL add\-ons.
* Design and validate testing approaches, ensure system quality, stability, and compliance with standards.
* Ensure high\-quality documentation, code reviews, and solution transparency.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Understanding of Facility Management area of Planon
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Planon configuration and customization.
* Deep understanding of Planon business rules, workflows, and FM processes.
* Strong experience with Java, JavaScript, and SQL in a Planon context.
* Proven experience with Planon Web Frontend and mobile configurations.
* Ability to work independently in a global, cross\-functional environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

cb455166.title: Delivery Manager Operations - English & Exams
cb455166.description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
   

  

 Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
   

  

**We connect. We inspire.**
**Pay Band** 
 : 6
   

  

**Country/Location:** 
 Noida, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 GSS English \& Exams (IELTS Operations)
   

  

**Contract Type** 
 : 1 Year Fixed term contract
   

  

**Work Schedule:** 
 This is a 24/7 on\-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift\-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week
   

  

**Training \& Assessment Requirement**
 Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicab
   

  

**Role Description/Purpose**
 The Delivery Manager – Operations is responsible for leading and managing end\-to\-end Finance Operations service delivery to ensure it is efficient, scalable, and consistently meets business and customer expectations. The role focuses on designing and implementing robust service delivery frameworks, including workforce planning, utilisation, and process optimisation, while ensuring adherence to defined service level agreements and quality standards. It plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and operational excellence across shared services, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure business continuity. The role also ensures strong governance, reporting, and compliance practices, enabling reliable and high\-quality outcomes for stakeholders and customers in a global operating environment.
   

  

**Role Accountabilities**
 The role operates within the English \& Examinations business, a key strategic and revenue\-generating unit of the organisation, delivering services across a global network of over 100 countries. It functions in a shared services environment that supports multi\-country operations, requiring high levels of standardisation, automation, and efficiency in processes. The Delivery Manager must balance ongoing service delivery with transformation and digital initiatives in a cost\-conscious and resource\-constrained setting, working closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business priorities, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements, while maintaining uninterrupted service delivery.
   

  

 You will lead end\-to\-end delivery of Finance Operations services, defining and implementing service delivery frameworks covering staffing, scheduling and utilisation, and ensuring SLA compliance and high\-quality customer interactions. You will establish escalation mechanisms and helpdesk structures, monitor risks and ensure mitigation and business continuity planning, and drive process standardisation to reduce operational inefficiencies. You will also ensure adherence to information security policies (ISO 27001/22301\), monitor access controls and compliance within your teams, drive a security awareness and incident reporting culture, and ensure immediate action is taken in case of non\-compliance or risks.
   

  

 You will maintain strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders, communicating performance, issues and insights to leadership, managing MIS reporting on a daily, weekly and monthly basis, aligning service delivery with stakeholder expectations, and facilitating stakeholder reviews, governance forums and visits. On people and resource management, you will manage recruitment, onboarding and training of teams, drive performance management and productivity improvements, implement engagement and retention initiatives, and build a high\-performing, motivated operations team.
   

  

 On quality, you will ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards, deliver against KPIs and quality benchmarks, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and manage customer feedback and complaint resolution. On governance and reporting, you will provide insights through dashboards, reports and analytics, ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory and legal requirements, identify, assess and manage operational risks, and strengthen governance frameworks and reporting accuracy.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduation in Commerce
* Written and verbal proficiency in English (British Council systems and global processes operate in English)
* 7\+ years of experience in Finance Operations (O2C / R2R) / Shared Services
* 4\+ years of people management experience
* Strong understanding of finance governance and controls
* Experience in reporting, dashboards, and MIS
* Experience in operational delivery in a global/shared services environment
* Strong understanding of Finance Operations \& Shared Services delivery
* Expertise in financial governance and compliance frameworks
* Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills


**Desirable**
* Lean / Six Sigma certification
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Experience in transitions / migrations
* Exposure to global capability centres


**Further Information**
 Right to Work: Locally recruited
   

  

 Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work.
   

  

 Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on\-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided.
   

  

**India (OCI)**
 Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
   

  

 Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in
   

  

 Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on\-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift\-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position and it requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
   

  

**Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement**
 We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.
   

  

**Safeguarding Statement**
 The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989\. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.

81b4818b.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
81b4818b.description:
**Summary**
 Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second\-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We deliver SaaS solutions via Guidewire Cloud that enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Our Application Platform helps internal developers and customers build innovative insurance applications with the aim to boost developer productivity, establish a vendor ecosystem and leverage the latest cloud technologies.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, you will play a key role within Application Platform organization, driving projects internally (and with other teams). You will be responsible to drive and coordinate major platform and cloud service initiatives with the highest degree of complexity. Your impact will be felt across the organization. You will spend a significant proportion of your time developing the capabilities of the team as a whole.
   

  

**Job Description**
 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end planning and execution of complex, multi‑team technical programs across platform, cloud operations, product engineering, data, and security to support PDO’s goals in reliability, security, and gross margin improvement.
* Partner with engineering, product management, design, QA, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to define scope, problem statements, success metrics, and delivery milestones for initiatives such as GenAI “lifts,” cloud reliability improvements, and new platform capabilities.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously refine integrated program plans—including timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and release plans—to ensure programs land on time, within scope, and with clearly defined business outcomes.
* Manage cross‑functional dependencies, proactively identify and remove blockers, and escalate risks with data‑driven options so teams can move quickly while maintaining quality, compliance, and customer trust.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies, technical deep dives, architecture and design discussions, and regular program syncs that align teams around priorities, trade‑offs, and delivery commitments across loosely coupled domains.
* Implement and evolve program governance, reporting cadences, and operational best practices that improve transparency, decision‑making, and execution efficiency across PDO and partner organizations.
* Define and own program‑level KPIs (e.g., reliability, incident metrics, development velocity, technical debt reduction, cloud and data platform adoption, infrastructure stability), track variances, and drive course‑corrections based on data and continuous feedback.
* Ensure technical readiness for production releases—including security posture, scalability, performance, disaster recovery dependencies, and operational health—aligned with Guidewire’s security and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with leadership to drive change management, refine processes, and align programs with Guidewire’s broader vision to embed AI and GenAI across products and operations, including initiatives like the Agentic AI Platform and cloud adoption accelerators.
* Influence platform and tooling direction by identifying opportunities to streamline developer workflows, improve operational efficiency, and better support AI, cloud, and data platform adoption across PDO and other teams.
* Manage relationships with vendors and third‑party service providers where applicable, including contract and SLA considerations, to ensure external dependencies support program outcomes and service reliability.
* Act as the “glue” that connects high‑velocity, distributed teams, ensuring alignment with Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers operate through a secure, scalable, AI‑enabled cloud platform.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of total professional experience, including 5\+ years in technical program management driving complex, multi‑team software initiatives, preferably in cloud, infrastructure, or platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile or hybrid delivery models, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, operations, and security teams.
* Solid grasp of modern software architecture, cloud systems (e.g., distributed, multi‑tenant SaaS), and platform engineering concepts such as reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Proven track record of designing and running metrics‑driven programs: defining KPIs, building dashboards or reporting mechanisms, and using data to guide decisions, communicate impact, and improve program performance.
* Hands‑on experience with engineering planning and tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Confluence, Google Sheets) to manage backlogs, dependencies, and status reporting at scale.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical topics for executives and non‑technical partners, and to drive alignment among diverse viewpoints.
* Proficiency with change management principles and techniques—able to guide teams through new processes, tools, and ways of working while minimizing disruption and resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience leading programs related to cloud operations, platform reliability, AI/ML or GenAI features, or large‑scale data platforms.
* Background in or exposure to P\&C insurance or other highly regulated industries, particularly in cloud or SaaS environments.
* Experience with vendor management, including understanding of SLAs, contract implications, and how external partners fit into critical program paths.
* Prior experience in organizations undergoing significant cloud, AI, or data platform transformation, especially where operational excellence and innovation must be balanced.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent demonstrated technical proficiency through experience.


 Your Impact
   

  

 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in PDO’s FY26 VPMOM, understand our AI, cloud, and data platform priorities, and take ownership of one or more high‑impact programs—such as reliability and security improvements, GenAI‑enabled product capabilities, or cross‑region disaster recovery and readiness initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll establish program structures, clarify goals and KPIs, and build trusted relationships with engineering, product, security, operations, and go‑to‑market leaders. As your programs mature, you’ll be accountable for measurable outcomes like improved service reliability, faster time‑to‑market for AI‑infused features, increased adoption of cloud and data platform capabilities, and reduced operational toil. Your work will directly support Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI into a cloud platform that helps P\&C insurers operate more efficiently and deliver better experiences to their customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
   

  

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

a2e2852b.title: STAFF, TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
a2e2852b.description:
About Team:
   

  

 Building the right technology foundation for Infrastructure \& platforms is vital to success at the scale of Walmart. Our team builds and maintains the foundational technologies that support the tech organization. Included in this are data platforms, enterprise architecture, DevOps, cloud computing, and infrastructure. All of these products and services are supported by scalable and powerful infrastructure, ensuring a secure and seamless employee and customer experience across stores, digital channels, and distribution centers.
   

  

 What you'll doExecute and improve the Problem Management Correction of Error (COE) process in alignment with global and local standards.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to automate and optimize problem management workflows using Agentic AI.
   

  

 Coordinate problem resolution across internal teams, vendors, and external partners.
   

  

 Drive Correction of Error (COE), postmortem facilitation, and closure of critical action items.
   

  

 Ensure timely and high\-quality delivery of COE reports, Post Implementation Reviews, and known error documentation.
   

  

 Mentor junior Problem Mangers and engineers, fostering a culture of operational excellence.
   

  

 What you'll bring:
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 10\+ years of experience in IT operations, technical program management, or service reliability.
   

  

 Minimum 5 years of experience in Change/Incident/Problem Management or Project Management.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages, including building scalable backend services and data pipelines.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Sonnet) for prompt engineering, inference, and orchestration.
   

  

 Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent orchestration and workflow integration.
   

  

 Ability to implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or similar techniques to deliver explainable, context\-aware AI insights.
   

  

 Technical knowledge in system architecture, networking, and cloud platforms.
   

  

 Strong understanding of ITIL
   

  

 Experience with tools like ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence and Tableau
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.

* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

bd715ebf.title: Cloud Support Engineer
bd715ebf.description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 Customer \& Product Support (C\&PS) sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and R\&D teams. Through close teamwork and collaboration, we drive positive customer outcomes and ensure seamless access and optimal utilization of AlphaSense’s market\-leading platform and products. We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer \& Product Support team is based globally across the US, Canada, UK, India and Singapore.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive Cloud Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will own technical problems end\-to\-end within your scope including investigating, diagnosing and resolving customer issues across SaaS and private cloud environments. In your role day\-to\-day, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical customer contacts on more complex cases.
   

  

 You will be the second line of defense for technical queries, working at the intersection of customers, frontline support and Engineering. This is a strong foundation role for someone early in their cloud support career with some experience, who has demonstrated relevant technical skills, contributing to a high\-trust team and the ability to apply AI tools to scale their impact.
   

  

 Growth paths from this role include progression with the Support function to Senior Cloud Support Engineer and beyond, or a move into our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, supported by structured training and collaboration with Engineering.
   

  

 Who You Are
   

  

* A technically curious engineer with 2 \- 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
* A clear communicator in writing and on customer calls, with the ability to explain technical concepts with appropriate clarity.
* A problem\-solver with a proactive, customer\-first mindset and an eye for surfacing risks early.
* Adaptable, eager to continuously learn, and willing to ask for help when blocked.
* Energized by being part of an entrepreneurial team and willing to pull your own weight to help the team succeed.


 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Deliver exceptional technical support: Act as the second line of defense for technical queries, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer issues through close collaboration between L1 support and R\&D teams. Own the customer\-facing loop on your assigned tickets, driving them to resolution with urgency.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges: Diagnose issues using logs, traces, and reproducible test cases; work confidently with kubectl, awscli, and at least one scripting language. Resolve in\-scope issues completely and escalate out\-of\-scope issues to the correct engineering domain with high\-quality artifacts.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Partner effectively within the team and across regions and time zones; share knowledge proactively and close loops on commitments. Build working relationships with both account teams and R\&D as you grow your technical credibility.
* Documentation: Contribute to runbooks, KEDB articles, and FAQs. Maintain documentation hygiene on the issues you own.
* Be an advocate for customers: Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions and initiatives to maximize the value of our platform and products.
* Build working knowledge of the AlphaSense platform and core products. Identify your own knowledge gaps and build a plan to close them.
* Use AI tools in your daily work for technical investigations, log analysis, customer communication and documentation. Build repeatable prompts and workflows rather than one\-off use; share what works with the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2 \- 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
* Working proficiency with CLI tools (e.g., kubectl, awscli) and scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar.
* Working knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP\-related troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with connecting LLMs to external tools, including multi\-agent systems.
* Exposure to alerting and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, FireHydrant).
* Demonstrated AI fluency in day\-to\-day work: can speak to examples of how AI has changed the way they work.
* Experience managing customer support cases through their lifecycle from inquiry, triage, bug reporting, through to resolution.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and team members.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in networking and troubleshooting complex network issues
* Experience troubleshooting in at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and containerized environments using Kubernetes or Docker.
* Extensive experience working with GraphQL and other web APIs
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Crossplane, and related troubleshooting
* Experience with Search Technologies and Data Storages (e.g. Vespa, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, MySQL)
* Experience or familiarity with the Java programming language
* Experience with standard software release lifecycles.


 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
   

  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha\-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.


 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

d3cb92b5.title: Technical Account Manager
d3cb92b5.description:
FireMon has learned an unknown and unauthorized third party is impersonating FireMon HR as part of a phishing attempt. Communications from FireMon will always originate from the FireMon.com domain. FireMon will never ask for any banking information as part of an interview process. If you are concerned whether a communication from FireMon is legitimate, please contact us at \[email protected]
   

  

 FireMon is a recognized innovator in global cybersecurity, leading the way with disruptive technologies and forward\-thinking solutions. Here, proactive thinking is not just encouraged—it’s celebrated. Our fast\-paced, cutting\-edge environment fuels continuous innovation, shaping how we build products, support customers, and drive results every day.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a technical resource who advocates for designated customers and ensures customers' needs are known and managed across all offerings, including services, training, support, and product development. The TAM prioritizes customers' technical issues and communicates those priorities to support; communicates the status of services projects; conveys the needs and urgency of RFEs to product management and contributes to the product roadmap.
   

  

 You will provide customers with status updates of open tickets and development/services projects; the upcoming release schedule; issues trending; upgrade recommendations; and guidance through early access/beta programs. This role will also require periodic onsite visits.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Manage overall relationships with assigned end\-users, including increasing adoption, and ensuring retention and satisfaction.
* Provide project leadership for customers' major FireMon programs.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with FireMon teams—including Support, R\&D, Product Management, and Sales—to address customer needs and deliver high\-impact outcomes.
* Management, and Sales, on customers' technical issues and projects.
* Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of the FireMon product line.
* Provide hands\-on support to customers for system health checks, user and device management, troubleshooting, upgrades, and monitoring activities.
* Manage multiple customer engagements, balancing priorities and driving resolution across requests.
* Share insights and constructive feedback with internal teams to help improve products and customer experiences.
* Document best practices in developing and deploying FireMon solutions in the customers' environments.
* Be a technical resource for "best practice" and other customer questions, identifying alternate technical solutions to customers' business problems.
* Partner with account teams to manage expectations and provide a clear view of customer progress and health throughout their lifecycle.
* Commit to continuous learning by maintaining relevant certifications and gaining new ones each year.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or another related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in roles such as technical project management, technical account management, professional services, or similar customer\-facing technical roles.
* Three or more years of experience managing or architecting complex network infrastructures. This includes the architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting, and ongoing support of router/switch\-based and software\-defined virtual networks.
* Experience in client\-server applications, Unix/Linux system administration, or software development. Experience includes debugging and troubleshooting, upgrading software, and applying security patches.
* At least one active technical certification (e.g., CCNA or equivalent), with a willingness to pursue additional certifications annually as part of your professional growth.
* Understanding of modern software development methodologies, including infrastructure design and architecture best practices.
* Proven success in customer\-facing roles—especially in implementation, or support settings—where communication and relationship\-building were key.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical detail and customer impact.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple customer needs at once.
* Effective communicator with the ability to engage stakeholders across various roles—from hands\-on technical teams to mid\-level managers and senior IT leadership (CISO/CIO/CTO level) in enterprise environments.


**What it Takes to be Part of the FireMon Team**
 FireMon provides persistent network security for hybrid environments through a powerful fusion of real\-time asset visibility, continuous compliance, and automation. Since creating the first\-ever network security policy management solution, FireMon has delivered command and control over complex network security infrastructures for more than 1,700 customers.
   

  

 Our customers have unique and complex security problems that are difficult to solve. This doesn’t intimidate us, it inspires us. It pushes us to be more creative and find solutions to ensure their success. If this sounds like a movement you'd be interested in joining, we invite you to apply today.
   

  

 FireMon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees, and applicants for employment, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

db61b0ed.title: Service Delivery Manager
db61b0ed.description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most\-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Title:** 
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location: ETAP\-Delhi**
**Employment Type:** 
 \[ull\-time
   

  

**The job**
 We are looking for a Service Delivery Manager with deep expertise in utility operations, responsible for end\-to\-end delivery of RDSS/ADMS projects.
   

  

 This role provides sole accountability for project delivery, technical compliance, and client/vendor interface. The Service Delivery Manager will coordinate with the Engineering Manager and engineering teams but remain the single point of ownership for delivery quality, schedule adherence, and technical compliance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on technical knowledge of power distribution, grid automation, and SCADA/ADMS systems with strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Compliance**
* Full ownership of end\-to\-end delivery for RDSS/ADMS projects in utility/grid environments.
* Ensure strict adherence to:
+ Client\-specific technical specifications
+ Distribution system automation standards and grid codes
+ Engineering drawings, SLDs, protection schemes, and compliance documents
+ Contractual obligations and quality standards

* Review and validate engineering deliverables including:
+ SCADA/ADMS system architecture, configurations, and network diagrams
+ ETAP / power flow / short\-circuit / protection coordination studies
+ Communication network designs, telemetry integration, and automation logic
+ Technical reports, FAT/SAT documentation, and compliance certificates

* Identify risks, deviations, or non\-compliances and drive corrective/preventive actions.


**Client \& Vendor Interface**
* Act as primary client and vendor\-facing technical lead for project delivery.
* Lead technical review meetings, progress discussions, compliance audits, and design clarifications.
* Manage client escalations, change requests, and technical queries efficiently.
* Represent the organization in FAT/SAT, compliance audits, and project acceptance reviews.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with the Engineering Manager and internal teams to ensure:
+ Engineering execution aligns with project schedules, compliance, and quality standards
+ Clear technical expectations are communicated and delivered by engineering teams

* Track engineering progress against milestones and ensure timely availability of all deliverables.


**Project Planning, Reporting \& Governance**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, and milestone trackers.
* Monitor project health across scope, schedule, quality, and risk dimensions.
* Prepare and present structured project status reports to clients and senior internal management.
* Maintain complete technical documentation, including:
+ Compliance matrices
+ Risk and issue registers
+ Meeting minutes and action trackers
+ Final handover documentation


 Ensure adherence to internal delivery frameworks, quality systems, and audit requirements.
   

  

**Essential Requirements**
* Strong domain knowledge in utility/grid operations, distribution automation, RDSS, ADMS, SCADA, and smart grid technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with ETAP, power system studies, protection coordination, and distribution network modeling.
* Ability to interpret and validate:
+ Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
+ Protection schemes and relay coordination
+ Telemetry and SCADA/ADMS configurations
+ Compliance with grid codes and utility standards

* Familiarity with power system automation, smart grid communication networks, and data analytics integration.


 Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet) and reporting tools
   

  

**Desired Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical / Power / Automation / Instrumentation Engineering. Master’s degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in utility or grid operations projects, with focus on RDSS/ADMS or SCADA/Automation projects.
* Proven track record as single\-point delivery owner for technically complex, client\-facing projects.


*I*
**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

07ba54d4.title: Program Manager
07ba54d4.description:
**Role Overview**
 The Program Manager – OSAT is responsible for leading large, complex customer programs from concept through high\-volume manufacturing. This role serves as the single point of accountability for program execution—integrating customer requirements, engineering development, supply chain, and factory operations to ensure on\-time, on\-cost, and on\-quality delivery.
   

  

 A major focus of this position is operations readiness for new products (NPI to HVM transition), including capacity planning, qualification, ramp management, and alignment of cross\-functional teams within an outsourced semiconductor assembly and test environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Execution**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of multiple customer programs within the OSAT business unit.
* Act as the primary interface between customers and internal organizations (Technology Development, Factory NPI and Process Engineering, Operations/Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance).
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive structured program governance: stage gates, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
* Manage program financials including cost optimisation models, margins, and change management.


**Customer Engagement**
* Lead customer technical and business reviews, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and performance.
* Translate customer requirements into actionable internal plans.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure rapid issue resolution.
* Support commercial teams in RFQs, SOWs, and new business opportunities.


**Operations Readiness \& NPI**
* Lead NPI to HVM transition activities including:
+ Factory readiness (equipment, capacity, tooling, materials)
+ Qualification planning (DOE, reliability, process validation)
+ Yield ramp strategies and learning cycles

* Coordinate process development, product engineering, and manufacturing teams.
* Ensure BOM, process flows, test programs, and quality controls are production\-ready.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Chair core team meetings and drive accountability across functions.
* Manage risk registers, mitigation plans, and contingency strategies.
* Partner with Industrial Engineering on line design, cycle time, and capacity modeling.
* Align with Quality on customer qualifications, audits, and compliance.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Establish program management best practices, KPIs, and dashboards.
* Drive lessons\-learned and standardization across programs.
* Support digitalization of program tracking and factory execution.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, Industrial) or related field.


**Essential Attributes**
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Manufacturing operations, capacity planning, and yield management
+ Supply chain coordination and material readiness
+ Cost modeling and program financial management
+ Relevant years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, or advanced packaging.
+ Relevant years of experience in program/project management with direct customer ownership.

1f829567.title: Solution Architect
1f829567.description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers
   

  

**Job Title** 
 IT Manager, Supply Chain Planning –End to End Supply Chain Solution Architect \& KTLO Management
   

  

**Location** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Job Summary** 
 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic IT Manager, Supply Chain Planning who will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the technology solution that supports global supply chain operations—from demand planning and procurement through manufacturing, logistics, and fulfillment with the focus on, but not limited to, supply chain special programs under the supervision of principle solution architect as well as overseeing the "Keep the Lights On" (KTLO) operations across all planning functions and applications, ensuring seamless supported day\-to\-day supply chain activities. This role bridges business strategy with technical execution, ensuring scalable, integrated, and future\-ready solutions across existing legacy systems, future ERP, MES, WMS, TMS, and planning systems. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End to End Supply Chain Solution**
* Solution Architecture \& Design
* Lead architecture design for global supply chain solutions, including planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and order fulfillment under the supervision of the principle solution architect.
* Develop target\-state solutions aligned with enterprise standards and digital transformation goals across existing legacy systems, future ERP (SAP, Oracle, etc.), PLM, MES, WMS, TMS, and external partner systems.
* Ensure solutions alignment with business processes and KPIs for supply chain efficiency, visibility, and sustainability.
* Solution Delivery \& Governance
* Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles and design standards.
* Provide technical leadership during project execution, including vendor selection and design reviews.
* Maintain documentation of architecture artifacts and ensure compliance with security, data, and integration standards.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with business units (Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Customer Service) to define functional requirements.
* Work closely with enterprise architects, data architects, and infrastructure teams to ensure holistic solutions.
* Liaise with external technology partners, system integrators, and SaaS providers.


**KTLO Operations Management**
* Oversee supported supply chain activities daily to ensure uninterrupted operations across all supported business units that includes but not limited to planning.
* Maintain and optimize (planning) systems and processes to support consistent product availability and service levels across all supported business units.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address operational challenges and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify and address IT issues as primary point of contact and optimize infrastructure, hardware, software and processes, in close partnership with the GSC business team and driving GTO dependencies
* Engage in rigorous root cause analysis, problem solving and solution implementations
* Ensure system processes work in a manner that adheres to customer requirements
* Maintain and update systems and data – combination of legacy systems and Salesforce platforms
* Ability to identify systems problems, solution fixes, present to leadership, and implement changes


**Leadership and Management**
* Lead the planning and execution of special programs, including franchise expansions, portfolio adjustments, and new business trials.
* Lead and manage a team of technical resources located offshore, ensuring high performance, motivation, and professional development.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to align program objectives with overall business goals and supply chain capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning within the planning team


**Franchise \& Portfolio Planning**
* Analyze and manage the supply chain aspects of franchise operations, ensuring alignment with market demands and strategic objectives.
* Evaluate portfolio performance and implement planning adjustments to optimize product mix, inventory levels, and distribution strategies.
* Lead and support any Franchise and Portfolio initiatives and relevant system enhancements that includes but not limited to planning systems.


**New Business Integration**
* Collaborate with business development teams to assess supply chain implications of new business opportunities.
* Design and implement (planning) processes to support the successful launch and integration of new programs like AG International.
* Monitor and report on the performance of new initiatives, providing insights for continuous improvement.


**Project Deliverables** 
 Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
   

  

**Collaboration** 
 Work closely with onshore teams, to align offshore activities with overall business objectives and project goals. Must be able and willing to jump in hands on any administrative, production support, Project management and/or business analyst tasks as needed.
   

  

**Resource Allocation** 
 Efficiently allocate and manage technical resources to meet project / operation demands and optimize productivity.
   

  

**Quality Assurance** 
 Implement and maintain quality assurance processes to ensure the highest standards of technical delivery.
   

  

**Communication** 
 Facilitate effective communication between offshore and onshore teams, ensuring transparency and alignment on project status, risks, and issues.
   

  

**Problem Solving** 
 Proactively identify and resolve technical and operational challenges to ensure smooth project execution.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns or requirements.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. Or 10\+ years in similar IT solution roles focusing on planning and supply chain operations in consumer product industries.
* Experience Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT solution architecture with at least 4 years focusing on supply chain planning systems and at least 3 years in a managerial role. Deep understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain process and applications is a MUST. Expert in application support including problem analysis and resolution. Strong analytical and critical thinking mindset. Expert relationship management/networking skills with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable presenting to business stakeholders on a regular basis and Should be able to work independently under minimal supervision and be a good team player.
* Technical Skills Strong understanding of software development, IT infrastructure, and project delivery methodologies and
+ Must have experience in Anaplan, Blue Yonder ESP/Fulfillment, ETL tools like Informatica, Ascend, , Cloudworks. Porficient in SQL, Excel, JIRA.
+ Nice to have \- Google cloud, Data Quality and Governance .

* Leadership Skills Proven ability to lead and inspire technical teams, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to adapt, prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with advanced planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle SCM Cloud, BY ESP), Anaplan, OMS and WMS a strong plus.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
 We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .
   

  

 Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.
