f183023a.title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect-SENIOR MANAGER
f183023a.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 10\+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end\-to\-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross\-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit\-to\-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.


**Delivery Governance \& Program Leadership**
* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision\-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross\-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership\-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.


**Integration, Data \& Technical Oversight**
* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and third\-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean\-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit\-to\-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post\-go\-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP \& Transformation Expertise**
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross\-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.


**Technical Architecture Skills**
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.


**Leadership \& Consulting Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and risk management skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

7ba489f3.title: Delivery Lead - Social & Search Ops
7ba489f3.description:
* **Title** 
 : Delivery Lead — Social \& Search Ops
* **Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings** 
 : 2\-11 pm



  





**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social \& Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client\-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end\-to\-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high\-growth environment, this is the role.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the revenue number for the Social \& Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM\-level resolution
* Present portfolio\-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C\-suite, VP\-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client\-facing ownership vs. CS\-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health



  





**What You Will Own** 



* The revenue performance of the Social \& Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross\-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves



  





**What You Bring** 



* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3\+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P\&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of paid media (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, programmatic) — you can review a campaign setup and identify problems, even if you no longer run accounts yourself
* Commercial acumen — you understand margin, renewal economics, upsell signals, and how to have a pricing or scope conversation with a client
* Experience running operations at scale — multiple clients, multiple channels, multiple team members simultaneously
* Strong executive communication — you are credible in a C\-suite room, and you can translate campaign performance into business outcomes without losing the audience
* Bangalore\-based or willing to relocate — this is a full\-time, in\-office leadership role



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in performance marketing agencies — multi\-client ops and client servicing discipline is a strong advantage
* Experience in recruitment advertising, employer branding, or HR tech — shortest ramp time into Joveo's client context
* P\&L ownership or revenue target accountability in a previous role — not just budget management
* Experience building or restructuring a team from the ground up
* Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Presales and Opportunity Solutioning** 



* Lead technical solutioning for Cloud and Infrastructure Services opportunities across RFIs, RFPs, proactive pursuits, renewals, expansions and transformation programs.
* Analyze customer business goals, technical requirements, existing infrastructure landscape, service levels, operations challenges and contractual requirements.
* Develop compelling solution strategies, win themes, transformation hypotheses, value propositions and solution differentiators.
* Own the technical response from initial opportunity qualification through proposal submission, customer presentation and SOW preparation.



**2\. Cloud Transformation Solutioning** 



* Architect solutions across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud and multi\-cloud environments.
* Design cloud landing zones covering account or subscription structure, identity, network connectivity, security, governance, monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery and cost management.
* Develop cloud adoption, migration, consolidation and modernization roadmaps.
* Develop migration factories, wave plans, effort models, migration schedules, cutover approaches, testing strategies and hypercare models.
* Use native AWS and Azure pricing tools to create infrastructure configurations, consumption estimates and commercial inputs.



**3\. Data Center and Hybrid Infrastructure Solutioning** 



* Design transformation and managed services solutions for enterprise data center and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Design data center migration, consolidation, exit and cloud\-adoption solutions.
* Incorporate high availability, DR, backup, security, performance and regulatory requirements into the solution architecture.



**4\. Managed Services Solutioning** 



* Design end\-to\-end managed services solutions for cloud, data center and hybrid infrastructure operations.
* Define service delivery models covering shared, dedicated, offshore, nearshore and onsite constructs.
* Design automation\-led operating models using AIOps, event correlation, orchestration, self\-healing, infrastructure as code and automated remediation.
* Develop productivity and optimization roadmaps with clearly defined and supportable benefits.



**5\. Commercial and Deal Support** 



* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive and financially viable pricing models.
* Build bottom\-up effort estimates for transformation projects and managed services.
* Support deal\-shaping decisions including scope optimization, delivery location, resource mix, automation benefits and risk provisions.
* Identify solution and commercial risks and recommend appropriate mitigations.
* Participate in internal deal reviews, governance checkpoints and approval processes.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum
 **15 years of overall experience** 
 in IT infra, cloud and related services.
* Strong experience in
 **Cloud \& Infra Services presales and solution architecture** 
 .
* Demonstrable experience designing both:
* **Transformation solutions** 
 , such as cloud adoption, migrations, modernization, data center exits, consolidation and technology refresh.
* **Managed services solutions** 
 , including operating models, staffing, transition, SLAs, automation and service improvement.
* Strong experience with Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud \& enterprise DC technologies.
* Proven ability to independently build technical solutions, architectures, bills of material, resource\-loading models and pricing inputs.
* Experience working with globally distributed sales, delivery, practice, finance, commercial and partner teams.
* Prior infrastructure implementation or operations experience is desirable



**Educational Qualifications** 



* BE in Comp Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.



**Preferred Certifications** 




 One or more of the following would be desirable:
 


* AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, VMware certification, ITIL certification



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Strong commercial awareness
* Ability to work independently and take end\-to\-end ownership
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder\-management skills
* Attention to detail with focus on solution quality and commercial protection

6be30d45.description:
💼 We’re Hiring: Technical Account Manager
 



 📌 Location: Mumbai
 



 ⏰ Time: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
 



 🗓️ Working Days: Monday – Friday
 



 👤 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





 FirstHive is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager to drive customer success, deliver technical solutions, and identify account growth opportunities.
 



  





 What you’ll do:
 


* Work with clients and internal teams to gather requirements and design technical solutions
* Manage client deliverables, integrations, testing, and deployments
* Create BRDs, FSDs, user stories, solution documents, data maps, API formats, and test scenarios
* Conduct client demos and business reviews
* Monitor account health, manage risks and escalations, and drive customer adoption
* Identify upsell and expansion opportunities in collaboration with Sales



  





 What we’re looking for:
 


* BE/B.Tech in IT/CSE, BCA, or MCA
* 4–8 years of experience in Technical Account Management, Technical Solutioning, or Technical Product Management
* Strong experience in application/data integrations, requirement gathering, data mapping, impact \& gap analysis
* Hands\-on experience with Postman, JIRA, Databases, MS Office, and ChatGPT/LLMs
* Strong communication, analytical, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills
* Preferred: CDP/MarTech, MySQL, JavaScript, or MDM



  





 Why FirstHive?
 


* Fast\-growing global B2B SaaS startup
* Excellent growth opportunities and competitive remuneration

8501322a.title: Solution Architect – (AI Infrastructure & Hybrid Cloud)
8501322a.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a Solution Architect – (AI Infrastructure \& Hybrid Cloud) to lead the strategic design, architecture, and deployment of large\-scale, enterprise\-grade Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes environments. As a technical authority at the L4 level, you will be responsible for defining the blueprint of our cloud\-native infrastructure, ensuring it is secure, scalable, and highly automated.
   

  

 The ideal candidate acts as the bridge between traditional infrastructure and modern DevOps, serving as the lead design authority for global clients. You will collaborate with Network and Firewall Architects to build a unified fabric where containerized workloads, legacy data centers, and hybrid cloud environments coexist seamlessly through advanced automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and Design Enterprise OpenShift Solutions: Lead the high\-level design (HLD) and low\-level design (LLD) for multi\-tenant Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters across on\-prem and hybrid cloud environments.
* Define the technology stack, standards, and blueprints for deploying AI solutions across global, multi\-region public clouds (AWS/Azure/GCP) and diverse on\-premise hardware.
* Oversee the successful end\-to\-end rollout of critical services including AI SOC, OpenShift AI, and AI\-based Cybersecurity Log Optimization.
* Drive Network DevOps Strategy: Define and standardize the automation roadmap using Ansible, Terraform, and Python to achieve "Zero\-Touch" infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Lead Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary technical consultant for global clients, leading design workshops, architecture validation, and executive\-level technical reviews.
* Integrate Advanced AI apps, Networking \& Security: Collaborate with Pre\-sales, AI application developers \& Engineers, Firewall Architects to design secure AI agents \& use cases, container networking (CNI) models, implementing Zero\-Trust security, service mesh (Istio), and micro\-segmentation within OpenShift environment.
* Optimize Hybrid Infrastructure: Oversee the seamless integration of OpenShift with physical networking (Cisco ACI, VXLAN) and virtualized platforms (RHEL\-V, VMware ESXi).
* GPU \& Hardware Orchestration: Design and manage hardware acceleration using the NVIDIA GPU Operator and Node Feature Discovery (NFD). Implement Multi\-Instance GPU (MIG) and time\-slicing to optimize resource utilization across multi\-tenant clusters.
* Establish CI/CD Governance: Architect robust CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and application delivery, ensuring compliance and security are baked into the workflow.
* Lead Observability \& Reliability: Design comprehensive monitoring and logging architectures using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack to ensure 99\.99% availability of cluster services.
* Mentorship \& Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor L2/L3 engineers, providing expert\-level escalation support and establishing best practices for the DevOps and Network teams.
* Innovation \& R\&D: Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Advanced Cluster Security (ACS), and Cloud\-Native Networking (OVN\-Kubernetes).


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in systems architecture, infrastructure engineering, or network DevOps.
* Expert/Architect\-level proficiency in OpenShift (RHOS), and Kubernetes architecture in large\-scale production environments.
* Experience architecting hybrid\-cloud OpenShift solutions involving AWS (ROSA), Azure (ARO), or Google Cloud.
* Proven track record in Automation \& IaC: Mastery of Ansible, Terraform, and Git\-based workflows to manage complex infrastructures.
* Deep understanding of Linux (RHEL) Internals: Mastery of kernel networking, storage drivers (CSI), and container runtimes (CRI\-O).
* Strong Network Background: In\-depth knowledge of BGP, VXLAN, and EVPN as they apply to connecting containerized workloads to physical data center fabrics.
* Experience in "Architecture as Code": Ability to develop and maintain compliance artifacts, design validation reports, and automated documentation.
* Excellent Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to manage high\-stakes customer relationships and lead cross\-functional technical teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA), Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift (Administration/Development), or CKA/CKS (Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Security), AWS/GCP Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* Security Focus: Exposure to DevSecOps tools (e.g., Quay, StackRox) and zero\-trust framework implementation
* Legacy Integration: Familiarity with Cisco ACI, Arista CloudVision, or Juniper Apstra for end\-to\-end automation integration
* Red Hat OpenShift AI (ROAI) expertise will be preferred
* Familiarity with LLM deployment requirements and vector database infrastructure
* Background in Cybersecurity infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, SOC \& VAPT platforms)
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure (Kubeflow, MLflow) and high\-speed telemetry pipelines


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

5353627b.title: Snowflake Solution Architect
5353627b.description:
Cittabase helps organizations modernize their data platforms and unlock value from enterprise data through cloud\-native architecture, analytics engineering, and applied AI. We're growing our Snowflake practice and looking for a Solution Architect who can design and deliver production\-grade data platforms while also pushing our clients toward Snowflake's newest AI and agentic capabilities.
 



  





 Role
 



  





 We're looking for a Senior Snowflake Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Snowflake\-based data platforms for our clients. This role combines classic data architecture and analytics engineering (dbt\-driven transformation pipelines) with hands\-on expertise in Snowflake's AI stack — Cortex (Analyst, Search, Agents) and Snowflake CoWork — to help clients move from raw data to governed, conversational, and agentic analytics experiences.
 



  





 You'll work directly with client stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable architectures, mentor engineering teams, and act as the technical authority on all things Snowflake across pre\-sales, delivery, and post\-implementation support.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Architect end\-to\-end Snowflake data platforms, including ingestion, storage, transformation, security, and consumption layers, aligned to client business requirements and cost/performance goals.
* Design and govern dbt\-based transformation pipelines (models, tests, macros, documentation, CI/CD) that serve as the semantic and quality backbone of the platform.
* Build and configure semantic views, Cortex Analyst setups, and Cortex Search services to power natural\-language querying over structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* Design and deploy Cortex Agents and Snowflake CoWork implementations, including agent instructions, tool/MCP integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Salesforce, email), automations, and reusable Skills for client knowledge workers.
* Define and enforce data governance, including role\-based access control, row\-access policies, column\-level masking, and cost/budget controls across warehouses and AI workloads.
* Own Snowflake account and warehouse architecture decisions: sizing, cost optimization, workload isolation, data sharing, and multi\-cloud/region considerations.
* Partner with client and internal engineering teams to review code, unblock delivery issues, and ensure architecture best practices are followed throughout implementation.
* Support pre\-sales activities: solution scoping, technical proposals, architecture diagrams, and client\-facing demos of Snowflake Cortex and CoWork capabilities.
* Stay current with Snowflake's evolving AI/agentic feature set and proactively recommend adoption paths to clients.
* Mentor mid\-level and junior data engineers on Snowflake, dbt, and AI\-native data patterns.



  





**Qualifications**




  




* 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or solution architecture roles, with at least 3\+ years working hands\-on with Snowflake in a production environment.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining dbt projects at scale (models, tests, snapshots, macros, packages, CI/CD integration).
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake Cortex, including Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and building or configuring Cortex Agents.
* Direct experience implementing or administering Snowflake CoWork (or Snowflake Intelligence), including semantic views, agent instructions, automations, and Skills.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of dimensional modeling, ELT/ETL patterns, and data warehouse performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake governance features: RBAC, row\-access policies, dynamic data masking, and resource monitors/budget controls.

f5b44eee.title: Senior Oracle Cloud SCM Techno-Functional Architect
f5b44eee.description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Senior Oracle Cloud SCM Techno\-Functional Architect, based in our Noida or Bangalore office, to sit at the intersection of our product team and our customers. You will help expand the SCM capabilities of Config Agent and Testing Agent, the automation engines our customers rely on for Oracle configuration migration and test execution, and based on need, support delivery for customers running these products on live Oracle SCM programs.
   

  

 This is not a classic implementation consulting role. You will bring deep Oracle SCM functional and technical knowledge into product development: defining how our agents should handle SCM setups, FBDI conversions, extracts, APIs, and integration touchpoints, validating product behavior against real Oracle environments, and stepping into customer engagements where deep SCM expertise is needed to unblock delivery.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Product capability expansion: Partner with product and engineering to design and expand Config Agent and Testing Agent capabilities across Oracle Cloud SCM, including functional setup migration via FSM, FBDI/LOADERS, and setup APIs.
* Architecture ownership: Define the technical architecture for how Opkey agents discover, extract, transform, and load Oracle SCM configuration and transactional data, and how they validate results post\-load.
* Conversions and transformations: Bring authoritative expertise on SCM data conversion and transformation strategy: source\-to\-target mapping, transformation logic, load sequencing, error handling, and reconciliation.
* SCM functional depth: Define how core Oracle SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing) are configured end to end, so agent automation reflects real setup dependencies, sequencing, and how Oracle actually behaves in customer environments.
* Integrations: Advise on integration patterns across OIC, REST/SOAP web services, and ESS scheduling, and how Opkey automation should exercise and validate them.
* RICEF architecture: Apply full RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms/Workflows) build and architecture experience to shape agent coverage, test design, and configuration scope decisions.
* Customer delivery support: Support Config Agent and Testing Agent customers during SCM implementations and quarterly Oracle releases, troubleshooting complex Oracle\-side issues, validating agent behavior, and advising customer and SI partner technical teams.
* Release advisory: Contribute to functional and technical advisory content on Oracle release cycles (26A to 26D and beyond), migration paths, and platform changes that affect customers and product roadmap.


 What you bring
   

  

* 10\+ years of hands\-on Oracle Cloud SCM implementation experience as a techno\-functional consultant, acting in a lead or architect capacity.
* Deep, practitioner\-level expertise in FBDI/LOADERS: business object structures, load orchestration, error resolution, and large\-volume conversion strategy.
* Deep understanding of backend tables, metadata, and how to query with SQL.
* Proven delivery of data conversions and transformations from legacy systems (EBS, PeopleSoft, SAP, Workday, or homegrown) into Oracle Cloud SCM.
* Functional depth across core SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing), with proven ownership of FSM setups, organization structures, and cross\-module dependencies.
* Integration build experience across OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, and ESS jobs.
* Full\-lifecycle RICEF build and architecture experience: you have designed, built, tested, and supported these objects in production.
* Redwood / Visual Builder Studio familiarity and awareness of Oracle's UI extensibility direction.
* AI Agent Studio experience
* Working knowledge of Oracle configuration frameworks: FSM, security and roles, flexfields, lookups, value sets, and profile options.
* Ability to translate Oracle platform behavior into product requirements: you can explain to engineers why Oracle works the way it does and what automation must account for.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: this role spans product development, technical advisory, and live customer delivery.
* Clear written and verbal communication for executive, partner, and customer audiences.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Exposure to test automation platforms or ERP testing practices.
* Experience with agentic AI, LLM\-based tooling, or automation frameworks (Playwright, RPA).
* Experience with Manufacturing, Supply Planning, Logistics, or Maintenance modules.
* Big four consulting experience.


 Why this role
   

  

 You will shape how an entire category of Oracle SCM automation works, not for one customer but for every customer running Opkey. Your Oracle expertise becomes product capability with compounding reach, and you keep direct customer contact so your knowledge stays sharp and current with each Oracle release.
   

  

 Opkey is an equal opportunity employer. To apply, contact the Opkey talent team with your CV and a summary of relevant Oracle Cloud SCM delivery experience.
   

  

 Skills: cloud scm,,scm,fbdi,,loaders,,fsm,,supply chain management,oracle scm,ricef,

**Position Title:** 
*Principal\- Cloud \& Infra* 




  





**Location:** 
 India (Chennai and Bangalore preferred)
 



  





**Job Description:** 
 Digitide is looking for a Service Line Owner to lead Cloud \& Infrastructure service line globally. This is a senior role responsible for growing the Cloud \& Infra business through large managed services deals, deepening strategic hyperscaler partnerships (AWS, Microsoft, Google), and driving cloud architecture/modernization, cybersecurity, and AI\-led Master Systems Integration (MSI) as core pillars of the portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the global Cloud \& Infra service line across Workplace/End\-User Computing, Network, and Data Center/Cloud services.
* Lead the shaping, negotiation, and closure of large and managed services deals (multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar TCV) spanning infrastructure outsourcing, cloud managed services, and workplace/network operations.
* Own and grow strategic hyperscaler relationships with AWS, Microsoft (Azure), and Google Cloud — co\-sell motions, joint solutioning, partner funding/incentive programs, and specialization/competency certifications.
* Define and drive the cloud architecture and modernization roadmap — legacy\-to\-cloud migration factories, application modernization, FinOps, and cloud\-native reference architectures for enterprise clients.
* Embed cybersecurity into the infra portfolio — oversee security\-by\-design architecture, and build/scale managed security offerings.
* Champion Digitide's AI\-led Master Systems Integrator (MSI) positioning — orchestrating multi\-vendor technology stacks (cloud, security, automation, AI/LLM tooling) into unified client outcomes.
* Represent Cloud \& Infra in CEO/CXO\-level client and analyst conversations across US and India geographies, and act as the executive escalation point for large managed services accounts.
* Partner with Presales, Alliances, and Analyst/Advisor Relations to shape competitive, differentiated infra offerings, solutions and bids
* Strengthen Digitide's positioning in analyst rankings.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 15\-20 years of progressive experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Cybersecurity services, including senior service\-line ownership roles
* Demonstrated experience working across US and India markets — managing distributed teams and US/India\-based client relationships.
* Proven track record leading and closing large/managed services deals (typically $10M\-$25M TCV) spanning infrastructure outsourcing or cloud managed services.
* Deep experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud at the partnership/alliance level (co\-sell, funding programs, joint GTM).
* Strong grounding in cloud architecture and modernization — migration methodologies, cloud\-native design, and FinOps/cost optimization at enterprise scale.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity domains relevant to infrastructure (network security, cloud security posture management, Zero Trust, managed SOC/VAPT services).
* Exposure to AI\-led infrastructure operations or Master Systems Integrator (MSI) delivery models is strongly preferred.



  





  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 This role puts you at the executive table, representing Cloud \& Infra directly to CEOs, CXOs, and analysts across US and India — with a real seat in shaping enterprise deals and strategic direction, not just executing on them. You'll build without bureaucracy, in a culture that prizes speed, agility, and entrepreneurial spirit, giving you the empowerment and flexibility to build the service line your way, backed by 55,000 associates and a 20\+ year global track record. And you'll grow at scale, joining an organization with a presence across 40 locations in 5 countries, offering the platform, resources, and runway to build something significant and be recognized for it. It's a rare opportunity to combine strategic ownership with the backing of a large, established global platform — and to leave your mark on how Digitide defines the future of Cloud \& Infra.

 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As a Senior Champion Program Manager (Sr. CPM), your role involves fostering growth, as well as establishing, and nurturing robust connections with Atlassian Champions across APAC supporting them to contribute to the community to have the most impact, and activating them in ways that support business priorities such as driving company user groups, community events, forum contributions, and content creation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

 As a Senior Member Of The Champion Engagement \& Experiences Team, You’ll Drive Engagement \& Operational Excellence For The Champion Program. You Are The Subject\-matter Expert And Owner For The Operational Backbone, Keeping The Systems, Documentation, And Engagement Mechanics That The Whole Team Runs On Healthy And Scalable. * Drive program operational excellence: the health of the Champion tech stack, internal and external documentation management, and engagement health metrics

**ABOUT THE ROLE:** 




 The Technical Solution Expert is the technical bridge between Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You'll own the deep technical work that doesn't fit a standard playbook \- running discovery, designing integrations, scoping architecture, and demoing solutions for our most technically complex accounts, from first sales conversation through implementation handoff. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role for someone who's as comfortable reading API docs and sketching a data flow as they are presenting to a room of engineers and executives.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO:** 




  





**Discovery, Demos \& Solutioning:** 



* Partner with Sales and CS to review deal context, technical requirements, and commitments made during the sales cycle.
* Lead technical discovery calls with prospects and customers to uncover existing systems, data structures, workflows, and integration needs.
* Deliver tailored product demos, live walkthroughs, and proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) that highlight product value for technical and business stakeholders alike.
* Answer complex technical and security questions from customer IT, security, and executive stakeholders during the sales and evaluation process.



  





**Solution Design \& Architecture:** 



* Design integration and configuration plans, including API\-level customization, data mapping, and workflow design \- for accounts with non\-standard requirements.
* Design integration architectures, data flows, and configuration guidelines using RESTful APIs and cloud tools.
* Produce clear scoping documents and architecture diagrams that Implementation and Engineering can execute against.
* Troubleshoot edge cases that fall outside the standard implementation playbook.



  





**Handoff \& Cross\-Functional Partnership:** 



* Act as the technical point of contact for complex accounts during the transition from Sales to Implementation.
* Share customer feedback and recurring integration gaps with Product and Engineering to influence the software roadmap.
* Maintain documentation of common integration patterns to reduce repeat scoping work over time.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Less than 5 years in a technical, customer\-facing role, Solutions Engineering, Technical Implementation, Technical Consulting, or similar.
* Comfortable reading API documentation and working with webhooks/integrations.
* Strong ability to translate a customer's business problem into a technical plan and explain that plan to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience scoping or designing integrations between SaaS platforms (CRM, marketing automation, data warehouses, etc.).
* Comfortable owning ambiguity, this role deals with the accounts that don't fit the standard playbook.
* Prior experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in a sales\-engineering, implementation, or technical CS function.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience building or configuring AI agents or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building/using MCP\-based tools and connectors.
* Experience designing or training custom “skills” for an AI assistant or LLM\-based product feature.



  





**THE PAPERFLITE DIFFERENCE:** 



* Work and learn from a talented team that is building an industry\-first solution.
* No rigid hierarchy, with a friendly environment that fosters creativity and innovation.
* A fully stocked delicious pantry with snacks, drinks and treats for you to enjoy.
* Sweat it out, sans cost with our fitness program that lets you choose any fitness centre of your choice.
* A fully covered medical insurance plan that will never make you grow sick of hospital bills.
* We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.
* And, one of the more popular office perks: four lovable dogs and one opinionated cat who are always around for attention, treats, and the occasional cameo in meetings.

7f330a42.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
7f330a42.description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



  





 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Product Support helps Chargebee customers succeed after go\-live. We troubleshoot complex billing and subscription workflows, debug API and integration issues, and partner with Product and Engineering to improve reliability, reduce repeat tickets, and strengthen self\-serve through better documentation and tooling.
 



  





**About the role (Job Summary)** 




 You will own complex customer issues end\-to\-end across Chargebee’s product, APIs, and integrations. You will reproduce problems, identify root causes, communicate clearly with customers, and drive resolution with the right internal teams. You will also turn support patterns into better self\-serve content and actionable product feedback.
 



  





**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)** 



1. Build deep product and API expertise to deliver advanced technical support across email, chat, and calls.
2. Own and drive complex issues end\-to\-end by reproducing problems, troubleshooting systematically, and coordinating internal teams when needed to reach a confirmed resolution.
3. Provide consultative support by understanding customer workflows and guiding best\-practice configuration and integration choices.
4. Troubleshoot customer API usage and integrations, including payload analysis and debugging in a test environment.
5. Support integrations across CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce), finance platforms (NetSuite, Xero, Intacct), and payment gateways (Adyen, Authorize.net, Stripe).

8. Improve team efficiency through better workflows, tooling, and process improvements, while supporting customers 24/7 through rotational shifts.



  





**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)** 




  




1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
2. 3\+ years supporting a SaaS product in a customer\-facing role, with strong debugging and problem\-solving skills and a structured troubleshooting approach.
3. Clear, polished communication with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
4. Hands\-on experience with APIs, HTTP fundamentals, and tools like Postman

22ee1f6b.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
22ee1f6b.description:
**Company Description**
 Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Northern India area.
   

  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

97eb9077.title: Solutions Architect
97eb9077.description:
**About Nutpaa** 

 Nutpaa is an early\-stage deep\-tech company building a real\-time human movement perception and coaching platform that pairs on\-device capture and compute with a mobile app, cloud services, and a partner ecosystem. Our systems run analysis on the edge, protect user privacy by design, and are built for low\-latency, real\-time experiences.
 



 Our culture centers on technical depth, strong engineering ownership, peer collaboration, long\-term thinking, and patent\-protected innovation. This role is for a hands\-on technical leader who can hold the whole system in their head and guide a team to ship it.
 



  




**Role Summary** 

 We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the end\-to\-end architecture of our system the mobile app, cloud and application services, on\-device and cloud ML, edge runtime, and device integration and to guide our engineering team in delivering it as one coherent, production\-grade solution. You will make the technology, structure, and interface decisions that hold the system together, and you will be accountable for how well the pieces fit and how reliably they ship.
 



 A near\-term priority is taking our mobile app to production. You will drive that delivery end to end architecture, backend and device integration, security, performance, CI/CD, testing, and release readiness while keeping everything aligned to our core architecture principles: analysis compute on the edge, a fixed cue/telemetry protocol between device and app, and a privacy\-first, sealed\-box posture where only derived data leaves the device. This is a technical\-leadership role: primarily architecture and delivery guidance, but hands\-on enough to be credible in design and code reviews.
 



 The competencies that matter most to us: strong hands\-on cross\-platform mobile in both Flutter and React Native, solid backend and solution\-architecture depth, and offline\-first design done correctly (reliable sync, no data loss or duplicates) plus strong performance tuning and secure\-by\-default engineering. Cross\-platform mobile experience in both Flutter and React Native is a firm requirement; other tool names in this description are examples of the class, where equivalent experience counts.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Solution Architecture \& System Design** 

 • End\-to\-End Architecture: Own the architecture across mobile app, cloud/application services, edge runtime, and device integration how each part is built and how they connect.
 



 • Technology \& Patterns: Make and justify stack, pattern, and interface decisions; define clean, versioned API/protocol contracts between the app, services, and devices.
 



 • Non\-Functional Requirements: Set and enforce targets for performance, security, privacy, scalability, and reliability, and keep the system honest against our architecture invariants.
 


**2\. Mobile App to Production** 

 • Drive the Release: Own productionizing our mobile app end to end: architecture, backend/API integration, device/edge connectivity, deployment, and release management to production.
 



 • Production Readiness: Security and privacy (no raw video retained; only derived cues/authorized data leave the device), performance and latency targets, observability, and beta\-to\-production hardening.
 



 • Deliver on Milestones: Sequence the work, manage delivery against milestones and measurable KPIs, and get the app shipped on schedule and to spec.
 


**3\. Delivery Leadership \& Team Guidance** 

 • Guide the Team: Technically lead and mentor the delivery team full\-stack, UI/UX, CV/ML, and edge/hardware engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and clear standards; unblock them.
 



 • Engineering Discipline: Set the bar for SDLC, Git workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, and documentation, so the team ships tested, maintainable, production\-grade work.
 



 • Risk \& Governance: Run architecture governance; maintain a technical risk register; surface trade\-offs and dependencies early and drive them to closure.
 


**4\. Integration \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 

 • Make It Fit: Integrate mobile, cloud, and edge/device into one coherent system; manage cross\-module and cross\-team dependencies.
 



 • Stakeholders: Partner with the founder and, as it grows, the partner ecosystem; translate product goals into architecture and delivery, and support investor\-demo and beta readiness.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



**Experience \& Requirements** 

 • Flutter \& React Native: Minimum 3–4 years of strong, hands\-on experience in both Flutter and React Native.
 



 • Backend \& Solution Architecture: Minimum 3–4 years of solid backend and solution\-architecture experience.
 



 • Architecture Understanding: Strong understanding of mobile architecture, offline\-first design, APIs, cloud, and system design.
 



 • Delivery \& Hands\-On: Guides a cross\-functional team while staying hands\-on leads design and code reviews and dives into the code when it matters.
   




**Technical Breadth (tools are examples of the class)** 

 • Cross\-platform mobile \& offline\-first (required): Firm requirement hands\-on experience with both Flutter (Dart) and React Native. Plus offline\-first design with reliable sync (no data loss or duplicates); local databases (SQLite / Drift / Isar); background tasks; and state management.
 



 • On\-device \& cloud ML: Edge inference (TensorFlow Lite / ONNX Runtime / Core ML; Snapdragon / Jetson) and cloud ML \& serving (PyTorch, ONNX, Triton / TorchServe), including quantization, safe over\-the\-air model delivery, and embeddings \+ vector search.
 



 • Backend \& APIs: Python / FastAPI (or Node / Go); REST \+ OpenAPI; async, event\-driven services with a message broker (RabbitMQ / Kafka / SQS); Argon2id \+ JWT \+ SSO; and role\-based access control.
 



 • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage (S3\); append\-only / double\-entry ledger design with derived balances; and search (Postgres FTS, or Typesense / Meilisearch / OpenSearch).
 



 • Web: Next.js / Astro and Flutter Web, with judgment on web\-native vs code\-reuse per surface.
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps: AWS (or GCP / Azure); Kubernetes (EKS); Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions); infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); observability; multi\-environment; and cloud / GPU cost control.
   




**Non\-Functional \& Discipline** 

 • Performance Tuning (must): Proven ability to profile and optimize on mobile (frame rate / jank, startup, memory, battery) and on the backend (API latency, database query and index tuning, caching, and load testing) measuring first, then fixing the real hotspots against clear performance budgets.
 



 • Secure\-by\-Default (must): Builds security in from the start: a secure SDLC and OWASP Top\-10 awareness; strong auth (Argon2id, JWT \+ refresh, least\-privilege RBAC, SSO); secrets in a vault (never in code or the database); input validation and protection against SQL injection / XSS / CSRF; encryption in transit and at rest; dependency and secret scanning; and CI security gates. Given we handle sensitive personal and payment data, this is not optional.
 



 • Scalable \& Reliable Architecture: Designs systems that scale and stay reliable sound data modeling, caching, and awareness of data\-protection basics (consent / retention, residency).
 



 • Architecture Judgment: Spots the single biggest technical risk and de\-risks it early with a focused prototype; designs forward\-compatible, versioned protocols and contracts; makes pragmatic build\-vs\-buy calls.
 



 • Quality: A genuine habit of testing, CI/CD, and engineering discipline and of instilling it in a team.
   




**Preferred (Nice to Have)** 

 • Payments: Good exposure to payments and billing Stripe (Billing / Connect) or equivalent, subscriptions / wallet flows, and reconciliation.
 



 • Security / DevSecOps specialization: Deeper application\-security / DevSecOps depth threat modeling, SAST / DAST / dependency scanning (e.g. Snyk / SonarQube / Semgrep / OWASP ZAP / Burp), cloud security (IAM / KMS / GuardDuty), IaC scanning, penetration testing, and compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP). We may hire this as a dedicated role depth here is a strong plus.
 



 • Real\-time 3D graphics / body model: Real\-time 3D rendering on mobile (e.g. Filament or a comparable engine), glTF / GLB skeletal animation, level\-of\-detail, and performance / thermal tuning a strong plus, not a requirement.
 



 • Audio / Voice: Experience with audio/voice stacks text\-to\-speech (e.g. Polly / Google / ElevenLabs), on\-device TTS, and Bluetooth audio (A2DP / HFP).
 



 • Analytics: Product analytics and data pipelines PostHog (or similar) and a warehouse (BigQuery / Redshift / ClickHouse).
 



 • Edge / Device: Edge/IoT or device integration, BLE/pairing, or products backed by on\-device ML.
 



 • Domain \& Stage: Health/fitness or hardware\-connected consumer apps; and startup / 0\-to\-1 experience delivering under early\-stage constraints.
   




**What You’ll Gain** 

 • System Ownership: Own the architecture of an entire deep\-tech platform and see it through to production from an early stage.
 



 • Leadership: Shape both the technology and the team that builds it.
 



 • Patent Creation: Direct involvement in building patentable core technology.
 



 • Growth: A clear path toward Head of Engineering / Principal Architect as the company scales.
   




**How to Apply** 

 Interested candidates can send a CV and a short note about relevant work ideally with examples of systems or products you have architected and shipped to production to careers@nutpaa.com.

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.

beaf9a18.title: Associate Technical Consultant - Cloud - Devops,Kubernetes,Terraform,Scripting
beaf9a18.description:
**Scope**
* To work with the team (with guidance from a senior manager) to meet the objectives and deliverables of the team. Is expected to maintain focus and provide clear expectations to the team members, be the champion for the project within the team, demand excellence from team members, and support team members in their personal development. Keeps team members and stakeholders informed of key developments, issues, risks to the project and reports any project and people escalations in a timely manner.


**Current Technical Environment**
* Software/Tools: Java, Spring Boot, Groovy, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Codacy, GitHub Advanced Security, Black Duck Hub, BlazeMeter, Artifactory, Ansible, Docker, etc.
* Application Architecture: Scalable, Resilient, Event\-Driven, Secure Multi\-Tenant Microservices Architecture
* Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure (ARM Templates, AKS, Virtual Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NoSQL, RDBMS, Spring Boot, Snowflake


**What You'll Do**
 As a SaaS DevOps Engineer at the P1 level, you will be responsible for deploying and monitoring microservices, ensuring that solutions run efficiently within agreed SLAs, and supporting the implementation team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Seamless Application Support to Blue Yonder Customers
* Resolve customer cases, primarily low/medium severity, with occasional high/critical cases, demonstrating end\-to\-end ownership.
* Address internal proactive monitoring cases generated by Blue Yonder internal tools.
* Attend case quality training, ensuring adherence to SLA/SLO and quality practices.
* Achieve customer satisfaction through ownership, engagement, and proactiveness.
* Work under supervision from leads or mentors, constantly seeking guidance for quality improvement.
* Expected to work in shifts and provide out\-of\-hours support for 24x7 customer support.
* Communication and Collaboration
* Communicate effectively (verbal and written) with customers.
* Collaborate passionately and respectfully with various Blue Yonder teams and partners.
* Display professionalism and empathy during internal and external conversations, appreciating cultural differences.
* Building Competency
* Technical:
+ Develop basic skills in DBMS (e.g., SQL, Oracle) to write database queries and procedures for application support.
+ Gain experience in code debugging and platform support engineering (e.g., API and/or Mulesoft integration troubleshooting).
+ Troubleshoot mobile application issues.
+ Build basic skills in contemporary SaaS technical toolsets like AppDynamics and Splunk.

* Product and Domain:
+ Attend product boot camps to learn standard product features for resolving non\-complex issues.
+ Acquire basic domain knowledge to understand customer business processes.

* Solution Architecture:
+ Understand different cloud models (private, public, hybrid).
+ Learn about solution architecture and application deployment frameworks.
+ Familiarize with Azure concepts including:
- Native SaaS or containerized applications, Kubernetes
- Azure deployment models (e.g., serverless/PAAS, scale set, ASR)
- Azure automations and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Jenkins)

+ Engage in application health monitoring using M\&D tools.
+ Proactively identify and resolve application availability issues using defined resolution methods.

* Behavioral:
+ Develop a service mindset, consistently displaying customer\-centricity and ownership.
+ Seek regular performance feedback and focus on self\-development.
+ Proactively identify learning opportunities.

* Value Addition
* Contribute to Knowledge Centered Support (KCS) by:
+ Creating quality articles with minimal guidance from leads or mentors.
+ Leveraging existing articles to provide faster resolutions to solution issues.

* Identify opportunities for operational improvements (e.g., automation, process changes).
+ Proactively discuss identified opportunities with leads or mentors.
+ Collaborate with others to implement and operationalize improvements.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 1 yearsof Exp with product and cloud architects to design automated pipelines to support SaaS delivery and operations in Azure/AWS/GCP
* Hands\-on experience and/or significant familiarity with Cloud and automation tools/technologies such as (all not required): Microsoft, Google, Amazon CI/CD tool suites; IaaS, PaaS, SaaS tool suites; other tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub/BitBucket, Artifactory, Maven, Docker \& Kubernetes, etc.
* Solid understanding of and demonstrated hands\-on experience with collaboration tools (any 2\) JIRA, Confluence, visualization tools (Lucid Charts, Visio), Office Suite and SharePoint.
* Understanding of ITIL processes (Incident management, Request fulfillment, Change management, RCAs)
* Experience in shell scripting (unix, python)
* Proficiency in JIRA, , or similar Agile lifecycle tools; solid understanding of and demonstrated hands\-on experience in using Agile Project Management tools
* Work with company personnel to define technical problems and requirements, determine solutions, and implement those solutions.
* Provide technical feedback to engineering regarding product changes and enhancements.
* Deploy and automate deployment as well as monitor the client solution; make sure the client environments are up 99\.9999% of the time and meet the response time SLAs.
* Plan upgrades and executes towards the goal of moving all the clients to the latest version of the software.
* Make sure the deployments are secure and work with security team to harden the environments and fix any security vulnerabilities.
* Inspires the team to become better at their craft and trains the team both technically and functionally.
* Looks beyond the surface and fix the root causes rather than symptoms.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. * Data \& Applied Intelligence \- Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting\-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision\-making and transform businesses
* Product and Innovation \- Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage
* Technology M\&A and Strategy \- Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M\&A, integrations and carve\-outs
* Technology Transformation \- A\&M helps clients create a scalable, cost\-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities


**How You Will Contribute**
* Develop cloud architecture strategy, roadmaps, and reference architectures aligned with business goals
* Assess current cloud landscape and identify opportunities for modernization, cloud adoption, and infrastructure optimization
* Design and govern end\-to\-end architecture covering applications, cloud, infrastructure, security, and integration
* Design scalable, highly available, and secure solutions across on\-prem, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Drive cloud migration, cloud\-native, and hybrid infrastructure initiatives
* Define and enforce architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices, and review architecture and solution designs.
* Ensure solutions meet security, performance, scalability, resilience, and compliance requirements
* Review and guide on capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.


**Qualifications**
* 11\+ years of overall IT experience with 7\+ years in senior cloud architecture roles
* Strong experience in architecting cloud landing zone and other design patterns.
* Hands\-on expertise with AWS, Azure, or GCP (multi\-cloud exposure preferred)
* Deep understanding of cloud technologies, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V), storage, and networking
* Experience designing hybrid and cloud\-integrated infrastructure
* Strong knowledge of cloud security architecture, IAM, network security, and compliance frameworks
* Experience with microservices, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud\-native architectures

* Experience leading large\-scale digital transformation or cloud migration programs
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills
