07070e83.title: Data & AI Security Product Owner (Delivery Lead)
07070e83.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

 The Security Product Owner for Cloud Data \& AI is accountable for leading the development, execution, and continuous improvement of security capabilities across the cloud, data and AI platforms which support our Cyber posture. This role provides delivery leadership for globally distributed engineering teams and serves as a co\-owner of cyber product strategy and roadmaps in partnership with the Haleon architecture function. The position requires functional knowledge in cyber product capabilities, strong cross\-functional leadership, and the ability to influence without direct authority across engineering, architecture, operations, and cyber defense teams.
   

  

 The individual will directly manage a team of engineers and subject matter experts responsible for capability development, enhancement, and operational sustainment. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience delivering enterprise\-scale security capabilities, tracking and reporting measurable outcomes, and partnering with senior leaders (Director, VP, and occasionally CISO staff) to communicate progress, risk posture, and investment needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategic Planning \& Co\-ownership of Roadmaps
   

  

* Be accountable for cyber product controls across the Haleon Enterprise. Engaging with Data Teams, Cyber Defence and SOAR teams to ensure end\-to\-end integration of cyber products
* Own relationship and engagement with I.T. Operations and delivery functions
* Own relationship with vendors and suppliers across the Cloud, Data and A.I. product domain, initiating regular performance reviews and support procurement with renewals
* Provide regular reporting of status and progress to Haleon leadership
* Co‑develop a 3‑year cyber product capability maturity roadmap with Haleon’s architecture function.
* Contribute subject matter expertise on cybersecurity capabilities, detection and response enablement needs, and emerging control patterns.
* Ensure strategic alignment and end to end integration across all other cyber towers and business owners


 Product Ownership \& Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Serve as the primary owner of execution for all Cloud and IA Cyber products, capabilities, and enhancements.
* Lead cross‑functional delivery teams across engineering, architecture, and operations, ensuring consistent execution of roadmap commitments.
* Own the product backlog including intake, refinement, prioritisation, sequencing, and communication of delivery outcomes.
* Ensure security capabilities are designed and implemented for scalability, operational sustainability, and compliance with enterprise standards.


 Operational Responsibility
   

  

* Maintain shared responsibility for operational run‑state quality, ensuring that capabilities are reliable, measurable, and integrated into operational workflows.
* Ensure appropriate operational readiness before major releases, including runbooks, support processes, and monitoring.
* Partner with operations teams to address post‑deployment issues, scalability concerns, and continuous improvement opportunities.


**Performance Measurement \& Metrics**
* Manage and report on Vendor/Supplier KPIs
* Develop and maintain Key Control Indicators (KCIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) with reproducible, transparent measurement methodologies.
* Track and report posture, control effectiveness, adoption, and operational performance indicators.
* Present regular progress updates, dashboards, and risk summaries to Director and VP‑level stakeholders.


 Resource \& Cost Awareness
   

  

* Provide input into cost forecasting and monitor cost drivers related to cloud, AI and data security capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for delivering within cost expectations while not directly owning budget approval processes.


 Leadership \& Talent Development
   

  

* Work across matrixed organisation supporting Solution Architecture and Cyber Defence resource
* Directly manage and develop 3–5 engineers/SMEs, ensuring strong technical capability, performance management, and succession planning.
* Cultivate a culture of delivery excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.


 Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Partner closely with Cyber Defence teams (SOC, IR, Insider Threat, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence, and Forensics) to ensure capabilities support detection and response needs.
* Collaborate across cloud engineering, data platform, DevOps, and enterprise IT teams to drive adoption and integration of controls.
* Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to Director, VP, and occasional CISO\-level stakeholders.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 15\+ years of experience in cybersecurity product management, cloud/data security, or enterprise technology leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading delivery of complex, multi‑platform security capabilities in large enterprises.
* Strong technical literacy in cloud and data security concepts, including posture management, governance, data protection, and platform security. Understanding of Artificial Intelligence Risk management (IAM expertise not required).
* Demonstrated experience managing global teams and influencing across organisational boundaries.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience collaborating with architecture teams on multi‑year strategy development.
* Experience supporting SOC/IR/DFIR operations with integrated cyber capabilities.
* Background in tool rationalisation, integration strategy, and enterprise\-scale security modernisation.
* Professional certifications (preferred, not required).


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-09\-19
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

b0fa4534.title: Senior Technical Consultant / Architect
b0fa4534.description:
Introduction
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong technical expertise to support the implementation of SymphonyAI SCPO solutions for global retail customers.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing role focused on US retailer rollout support, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and implementation teams. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise application development, integrations, middleware, databases, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical workshops, define solution architecture, and support successful implementation and go\-live activities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Discovery \& Solution Design
   

  

* Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers to understand current system landscapes, integration needs, and technical requirements.
* Design scalable and secure technical solutions aligned with SymphonyAI SCPO capabilities and customer business objectives.
* Define architecture, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for implementation programs.


 Integration \& Technical Implementation
   

  

* Support end\-to\-end integration efforts across enterprise systems, planning platforms, ERP systems, and third\-party applications.
* Configure and support REST APIs, middleware, messaging systems, and data integration pipelines.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer IT teams to ensure successful technical implementation.


 Application Development \& Technical Support
   

  

* Provide hands\-on support across Java, Angular, .NET, shell scripting, and related technologies during implementation activities.
* Work with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux environments, and middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Support development and troubleshooting of J2EE, JSP, and web\-based application components.


 Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support
   

  

* Support integration testing, defect resolution, performance validation, and production readiness activities.
* Coordinate deployment support, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Proactively identify technical risks and ensure timely issue resolution.


 Documentation \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Create technical design documents, integration specifications, environment setup guides, and deployment documentation.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders, implementation teams, and internal engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support knowledge transfer sessions and provide technical guidance to customers and internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-10 years of experience in enterprise application development, technical consulting, or software implementation.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Angular, .NET, and bash/shell scripting.
* Experience working with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux, middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish, and web technologies including J2EE and JSP.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting integration testing, go\-live, and production support activities.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a customer\-facing environment and manage multiple technical stakeholders effectively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Python, Kubernetes, Data Lake technologies, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Familiarity with retail planning systems, supply chain applications, or enterprise retail platforms.
* Exposure to implementation projects for US\-based retailers.
* Experience working with large\-scale data integration and distributed systems.


**About Us**
 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact retail transformation programs.
* Exposure to leading global retailers and large\-scale implementation projects.
* A collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.
* Learning and growth opportunities across supply chain, retail, and enterprise AI solutions.

You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
  

  
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
  

  
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
  

  
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
  

  
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
  

  
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
  

  
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
  

  
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
  

  
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.
  


  


**Essential Experience \& Skills** 



  

  
* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
  

  
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
  

  
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
  

  
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
  

  
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
  

  
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
  

  
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
  

  
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.
  


  


**Desirable Skills** 



  

  
* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
  

  
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  

  
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
  

  
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
  

  
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.

484200a3.title: Engineering Solutions Lead, VP
484200a3.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title:** **Engineering Solutions Lead, VP**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title:**

**Role Description**

* We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on **VP, Engineering Solutions Lead** to drive the design and delivery of modern, cloud\-native enterprise solutions. This role combines deep engineering expertise with solution design leadership, focusing on **API\-first architectures, microservices, cloud platforms, and AI\-driven transformation initiatives.**
* The ideal candidate will possess strong system design capabilities, extensive experience building distributed applications, and a proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale cloud and AI solutions. They will be responsible for defining technical solutions, establishing engineering standards, and guiding teams through successful implementation while remaining close to the code and technology decisions.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise platforms and digital products.
* Define **end\-to\-end solution architecture** for complex business problems, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology standards and strategic objectives.
* Drive system design decisions across **distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, API ecosystems, and cloud\-native platforms.**
* Design and review REST APIs, service contracts, integration patterns, and data models to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Architect cloud\-native solutions leveraging modern public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* **Lead cloud transformation** and modernization initiatives, including application migration, containerization, Kubernetes adoption, and platform engineering practices.
* Define **AI solution architectures,** including LLM integration, AI orchestration frameworks, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent automation, and AI governance considerations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the software lifecycle, from architecture and design through deployment and operational support.
* Establish architecture best practices for security, observability, reliability, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Mentor engineering teams on modern architectural patterns, cloud engineering, system design, and AI adoption.

**Your skills and experience**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in designing and delivering large\-scale enterprise applications.
* Proven experience in solution architecture, system design, and building scalable distributed systems.
* Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event\-driven systems, API\-first design, and integration patterns.
* Strong experience designing and governing RESTful APIs for high\-volume enterprise environments.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including cloud\-native architecture and deployment models.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience designing highly available, fault\-tolerant, and performance\-optimized systems.
* Practical experience implementing AI and Generative AI solutions, including LLM integrations, RAG architectures, AI APIs, and intelligent automation use cases.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, security, governance, and compliance considerations within cloud and AI ecosystems.
* Proficiency in Java and/or Python with the ability to engage in technical design reviews and guide engineering teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence technical strategy across multiple teams.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, or regulated enterprise environments is highly desirable.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

a12a2a03.title: Enterprise Architect
a12a2a03.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 What we want from you
   

  

* Enterprise solution architecture across multiple products, teams, operational models, and business use cases.
* Ability to design scalable frameworks for platform reliability, health monitoring, operational insights, proactive issue detection, and executive visibility.
* Strong understanding of governance architecture, including access visibility, entitlement tracking, auditability, privacy, compliance, and operational accountability.
* Ability to identify gaps between business needs, operational needs, and current product capabilities, then define practical architecture patterns or prototypes to close those gaps.
* Cross\-platform Adobe Experience Cloud understanding across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, Analytics, Workfront, GenStudio, Experience League, and related integrations.
* Ability to translate complex platform signals into meaningful KPIs, value realization metrics, leadership reporting, and decision\-ready insights.
* Strong architecture judgment to decide what should be automated, standardized, monitored, governed, or escalated to product/engineering roadmap.
* Technical fluency with data, APIs, reporting, cloud platforms, and integration patterns, without the role being limited to hands\-on pipeline engineering.
* Strong technical leadership to influence cross\-functional teams, align stakeholders, guide implementation teams, and connect platform capabilities with measurable business outcomes.


 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 We are not looking for traditional AEP DA here. We are looking for solution lead who can guide team, unblock and help R\&I take to next level. Few points to consider...
   

  

* A traditional AEP Data Architect is primarily focused on core data architecture areas such as XDM design, datasets, identity strategy, ingestion patterns, data modeling, and activation readiness within AEP.
* The R\&I Solution Architect role is broader and more outcome\-driven.
* It focuses on making Adobe on Adobe reliable, governable, observable, automated, measurable, and scalable across teams and products.
* This includes designing solutions for platform health monitoring, data quality, access governance, operational insights, value realization, automation, and proactive issue detection.
* The key difference is that R\&I is not only designing how data flows through AEP. It is designing how the overall Adobe ecosystem operates successfully at enterprise scale.
* R\&I also helps close product gaps where out\-of\-the\-box capabilities may not fully meet Customer Zero needs, while partnering closely with engineering and product teams to influence future roadmap.


 In short, the R\&I Solution Architect role combines solution architecture, operational excellence, governance, automation, observability, and business value measurement. It is a strategic architecture role that goes beyond traditional AEP data design and directly supports the success and scale.
   

  

 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

94f94fee.title: Senior Program Manager
94f94fee.description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.

633b8279.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
633b8279.description:
**Description**
 The World Wide Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA capacity and inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory, and capacity. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in Country Business reviews (weekly/monthly/quarterly) forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build evidence\-based initiatives.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday (BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* MBA or Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field
* 8\+ years experience in program management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in inventory and capacity planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

acda20d9.description:
**Purpose of the role** 




  





 Cyberlite works from government policy to the classroom floor. We partner with ministries, schools and delivery partners across Asia Pacific to build cyber education that is sustainable, equitable and actually reaches the students who need it most.
 



 We're looking for a Delivery Lead who wants to work at both ends of that — in ministry meetings and in classrooms, often in the same week.
 



 You'll own delivery across the region. Running programmes and campaigns end to end, training local facilitators so the work continues after we leave, and holding the relationships that let us operate at scale across 16 countries.
 



 This role involves real travel. Southeast Asia, the Pacific islands, places most organisations never reach. If that's the appeal rather than the trade\-off, we should talk.
 



 You'll fit here if you've delivered education programming across Asia, you care about cyber safety and AI fluency, and you like small teams where everyone does the actual work.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Programme \& project operations** 




  




* **Partner with the management team to shape, build, and drive the operational strategy for Cyberlite's programmes, ensuring all activity is purposefully designed and delivered in service of project objectives.**
* **Play an active role in strategic conversations, bringing an operational lens to ensure what we commit to is actually achievable.**
* **Own the translation and execution of strategic decisions into clear, actionable plans — keeping teams aligned and accountable, progress visible, and risks surfaced early.**
* **Liaise with local partners, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.**
* **Maintain organised systems for project documentation, correspondence, agreements, and compliance records.**
* **Maintain a master activity tracker aligned to project timelines and deliverable schedules.**



  





**Partnerships** 



* **Working closely with the Partnerships \& Field Manager, own the full lifecycle of Cyberlite's relationships with third\-party implementation partners — from selection and onboarding through to performance management and close\-out.**

**Creative \& training team support** 



* **Work alongside the creative team to communicate field requirements for the production and delivery of educational content, toolkits, and public awareness materials — managing timelines and liaising with designers and instructional developers.**
* **Support the training team in recruiting and coordinating master trainers and facilitators, and organising trainer workshops.**
* **Execute the localisation and adaptation of materials for different country contexts, coordinating translation and cultural review processes.**



  





**Contracts \& administration** 



* **Draft and process MOA and subcontract agreements with local NGOs, civil society organisations, and consultants, with support from the Project Manager.**
* **Track deliverables and payment schedules for vendors, following up to ensure timely completion.**
* **Collect and organise required documentation from partners, including progress updates and financial records.**



**Support procurement processes for design services, printing, and other project supplies.** 




  





**Monitoring, evaluation \& reporting** 



* **Coordinate the administration of surveys and feedback tools for training workshops and student programmes.**
* **Compile operational data, activity logs, and progress information to support internal and donor reporting.**
* **Support the scheduling and coordination of stakeholder interviews, focus groups, and evaluation activities.**
* **Produce quarterly and annual reports for clients on project status.**



  





**3\. Person specification** 




  





**Essential** 



* **4\+ years in operations, project coordination, or programme administration — ideally in education, EdTech, international development, or a mission\-driven organisation.**
* **Experience coordinating external partners, subcontractors, or vendors.**
* **Fluent in Slack and Notion, or close equivalents, with a habit of keeping systems current without prompting.**
* **Working understanding of the contemporary online environment — platforms, algorithms, and online culture — and active curiosity about AI and its effects on young people.**
* **Based in Asia.**
* **Willing and able to travel a minimum of four times per year across Asia and the Pacific Islands.**



  





**Preferred (not essential)** 



* **Direct experience in online safety, digital wellbeing, child protection, or media literacy — in a programme, policy, research, or education setting.**
* **Familiarity with safeguarding or child online protection frameworks used across Asia\-Pacific.**
* **Experience designing or delivering for children rather than adults.**
* **Background in education, EdTech, or teacher training.**
* **Familiarity with the education or NGO landscape in India, the Philippines, and/or Indonesia.**
* **Additional Asia\-Pacific language skills.**



  





**Working relationships** 




**Reports directly to the Co\-founder's** 




  





**Works day\-to\-day alongside the M\&E analyst, creative team, training team, and Partnerships \& Field Manager.** 




  





**5\. Role details** 



* **Type — Full\-time**

**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer to join our Customer Success and Professional Services team. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will help customers leverage streaming architectures and applications to achieve their business results. In this role, you will interact directly with customers to provide software architecture, design, and operations expertise that leverages your deep knowledge of and experience in Apache Kafka platform, and complementary systems such as Hadoop, Spark, Storm, relational and NoSQL databases. You will develop and advocate best practices, gather and validate critical product feedback, and help customers overcome their operational challenges. Throughout all these interactions, you will build a strong relationship with your customer in a very short space of time, ensuring exemplary delivery standards. You will also have the opportunity to help customers build state\-of\-the\-art streaming data infrastructure, in partnership with colleagues who are widely recognized as industry leaders, as well as optimizing and debugging customers’ existing deployments.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Helping a customer determine their platform and/or application strategy for moving to a more real\-time, event\-based business. Such engagements often involve remote preparation; presenting an onsite or remote workshop for the customer’s architects, developers, and operations teams; investigating (with Engineering and other coworkers) solutions to difficult challenges; and writing a recommendations summary doc.
* Providing feedback to the Product and Engineering groups
* Building tooling for another team or the wider company to help us push our technical boundaries and improve our ability to deliver consistently with high quality
* Testing performance and functionality of new components developed by Engineering
* Writing or editing documentation and knowledge base articles, including reference architecture materials and design patterns based on customer experiences
* Honing your skills, building applications, or trying out new product features
* Participating in community and industry events


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Deep experience designing, building, and operating in\-production Big Data, stream processing, and/or enterprise data integration solutions, ideally using Apache Kafka
   

  

* Demonstrated experience successfully managing multiple B2B infrastructure software development projects, including driving expansion, customer satisfaction, feature adoption, and retention
* Experience operating Linux (configure, tune, and troubleshoot both RedHat and Debian\-based distributions) Experience using cloud providers (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) for running high\-throughput systems

* Experience with distributed systems (Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc.)
* Strong desire to tackle hard technical problems, and proven ability to do so with little or no direct daily supervision
* Excellent communication skills, with an ability to clearly and concisely explain tricky issues and complex solutions


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

09c08a73.title: Azure Platform SME — Solutioning & Pre-Sales
09c08a73.description:
**Role Summary**
 Avanade India’s Cloud \& Infrastructure practice is looking for an Azure Platform SME who can sit in front of a customer, understand their landscape, ask the right questions and shape the solution — then design and build it. This is a pre\-sales\-led role with real technical depth: the same person runs the discovery conversation, proposes the architecture, prepares the estimate and proposal, and stays hands\-on enough to design and provision the environment.
   

  

 We are looking for someone whose strength is consultative rather than order\-taking. Much of the value in this role comes before any design is written — in asking the questions that surface the customer’s constraints, dependencies and real drivers, and in proposing an approach that fits their landscape rather than a standard template.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead customer discovery discussions and workshops — understand the current landscape across on\-premises and cloud estate, applications, infrastructure, network, identity, security, operations and existing commitments.
* Ask structured, probing questions to surface business drivers, constraints, dependencies, compliance requirements, timelines and success criteria — and identify what the customer has not said as much as what they have.
* Translate discovery findings into a proposed Azure solution — target architecture, options with clear trade\-offs (cost, risk, effort, timeline), phasing and a recommended approach.
* Present and defend the proposed solution to customer stakeholders, from technical teams through to IT and business leadership, and adapt the pitch to the audience in the room.
* Prepare proposals and pre\-sales collateral end to end — solution write\-ups, architecture diagrams, bill of materials, assumptions, dependencies, risks, scope boundaries and SOW inputs.
* Own effort and cost estimation — Azure consumption sizing and pricing, resource\-level estimates, licensing considerations, and services effort estimates with clear assumptions behind the numbers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and customer questionnaires, working with sales, delivery and practice leadership to build a coherent and competitive response.
* Design Azure platform architecture: subscription and environment strategy, landing zone, networking and connectivity, identity, security baselines, governance, monitoring, backup and DR.
* Provision, configure and validate Azure resources hands\-on — building POCs, pilots and initial environments to prove the solution and de\-risk delivery.
* Shape migration approaches for customer workloads — assessment, sizing, wave planning, migration method and cutover considerations.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery teams and remain available as design authority — design reviews, escalation support and architecture governance through the engagement.
* Build reusable pre\-sales assets: reference architectures, solution templates, estimation models, proposal boilerplate and discovery question sets that shorten future pursuits.
* Engage Microsoft and partner stakeholders on joint pursuits, funding programmes and co\-sell motions where applicable.
* Mentor junior architects and pre\-sales consultants, and raise the quality bar on solution and proposal work across the practice.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8–11 years of overall experience in cloud solution architecture, infrastructure or cloud pre\-sales, with a strong recent focus on Microsoft Azure.
* Solid Azure platform knowledge across the core stack: compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and the platform services commonly used by enterprise workloads.
* Proven customer\-facing solutioning experience — running discovery discussions and workshops, understanding a customer landscape quickly, and proposing an appropriate solution rather than a generic one.
* Strong questioning and listening skills, with the judgement to challenge assumptions constructively and to identify gaps, risks and dependencies early.
* Hands\-on experience designing and provisioning Azure resources — able to build and configure environments personally, not only produce diagrams.
* Demonstrated pre\-sales track record: proposals, solution write\-ups, bill of materials, RFP/RFI responses and client\-facing presentations.
* Strong estimation capability — Azure sizing and cost estimation, effort estimation for services, and the discipline to document assumptions, exclusions and risks clearly.
* Experience designing Azure landing zones and migration approaches for enterprise customers.
* Azure networking depth: hub\-and\-spoke topologies, ExpressRoute and VPN, NSGs/UDRs, firewalling and routing, Private Link and DNS design.
* Working knowledge of Azure identity and security: Entra ID and hybrid identity, RBAC, conditional access, Key Vault and Defender for Cloud.
* Ability to produce clear, well\-structured architecture and proposal documentation (HLD, solution overview, migration plan) at client\-ready quality.
* Scripting capability in PowerShell and/or CLI for provisioning, configuration and operational tasks.
* Confident communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to hold a room of senior customer stakeholders.


**Preferred / Good To Have**
* Infrastructure as Code experience — Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates — and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Good to have, not essential; willingness to build this depth is expected.
* Microsoft certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), Azure Network Engineer (AZ\-700\), or security certifications such as SC\-100 / SC\-200\.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Intune/EMS and endpoint management as part of an integrated customer estate.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes — partner capability alignment, specialization readiness, Microsoft field engagement or distributor GTM.
* AWS or GCP exposure for multi\-cloud positioning and comparative solutioning.
* Familiarity with Azure AI and data services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric) and how those workloads land on a governed platform.
* FinOps awareness — cost optimisation, right\-sizing and ongoing consumption management.
* Experience in regulated or compliance\-heavy environments (BFSI, healthcare, energy, public sector), including data residency requirements.
* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment working with distributed teams.
* Prior contribution to reusable accelerators, reference architectures or practice\-building initiatives.

17552c18.title: Technical Architect - Sales Force Field Service
17552c18.description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Architect** specializing in **Salesforce Field Service (SFS)** to lead the design, delivery, and continuous evolution of field service solutions for our managed services clients. This role blends deep technical architecture expertise with strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills. The ideal candidate will act as the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of clients — translating business requirements into scalable, well\-governed Salesforce solutions while overseeing ongoing support, enhancements, and platform health within a managed services model.

This is a senior, solution\-focused role for someone who is equally comfortable designing complex technical architectures, leading solution workshops, mentoring delivery teams, and managing executive\-level client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Solution Architecture \& Technical Design**

* Architect end\-to\-end Salesforce Field Service solutions, including Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning (FSL), scheduling optimization, mobile workforce enablement, and integrations with ERP, IoT, asset management, and inventory systems.
* Design scalable data models, sharing/security architecture, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, middleware) that align with enterprise architecture standards.
* Own the technical solution blueprint from discovery through go\-live, ensuring designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Salesforce best practices and the Well\-Architected framework.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical health checks, and org optimization assessments for existing managed services clients.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate Salesforce products/features (Field Service, Omni\-Studio, Experience Cloud, Einstein/Agentforce, CTI) to meet evolving business needs.
* Define and enforce coding standards, DevOps/release management practices, and technical governance across the managed services portfolio.

**2\. Managed Services Delivery**

* Serve as the lead technical authority for a portfolio of managed services accounts, ensuring platform stability, performance, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee triage, root\-cause analysis, and resolution of complex technical issues escalated from support teams.
* Drive proactive roadmap planning, release management, and quarterly enhancement planning with clients.
* Manage technical debt, org complexity, and platform scalability over the lifecycle of the managed services engagement.
* Partner with project/delivery managers to scope change requests, estimate effort, and manage sprint/release backlogs.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and managed services governance frameworks.

**3\. Stakeholder \& Client Management**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for client stakeholders, from business users to C\-suite/IT leadership.
* Lead solution design workshops, technical discovery sessions, and architecture review boards with client teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant language for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Manage client expectations around scope, feasibility, timelines, and technical trade\-offs.
* Build long\-term, consultative relationships that support account growth, renewals, and expansion of managed services scope.
* Present technical roadmaps, health assessments, and strategic recommendations in client governance meetings (QBRs, steering committees).

**4\. Team Leadership \& Enablement**

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, consultants, and administrators within the delivery team.
* Review solution designs, code, and configurations produced by the team to ensure quality and adherence to standards.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution scoping, effort estimation, and technical proposal development (SOWs, RFP responses).
* Contribute to internal capability building, reusable assets, accelerators, and best\-practice documentation for Field Service engagements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of Salesforce implementation experience, with at least 3–4 years focused specifically on **Salesforce Field Service (FSL)**.
* Proven experience working in a **managed services / support\-and\-enhancement** delivery model (not just greenfield implementations).
* Demonstrated experience as a Technical or Solution Architect, owning end\-to\-end solution design and delivery oversight.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* Field Service core objects (Work Orders, Service Appointments, Resources, Skills, Scheduling Policies, Service Territories)
* Scheduling \& Optimization (complex scheduling policies, Optimization, Dispatcher Console)
* Salesforce Field Service mobile app configuration and customization
* Service Cloud (Omni\-Channel, Case Management, Entitlements/SLAs)
* Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and declarative automation
* Integration technologies (REST/SOAP, MuleSoft, Platform Events, middleware tools)
* Data modeling, security architecture, and sharing rules at enterprise scale
* Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements or accounts.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and DevOps/release management tools (Copado, Gearset, Flosum, or similar).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce certifications: **Field Service Consultant**, **Application Architect** or **System Architect**, **Sharing and Visibility Architect**, **Integration Architect**, Platform Developer II.
* Experience with adjacent technologies: MuleSoft, Tableau/CRM Analytics, IoT integrations, asset/inventory management systems.
* Prior consulting or systems integrator (SI) background.
* Experience in industries with heavy field operations (utilities, telecommunications, manufacturing, healthcare equipment, energy).
* Familiarity with Salesforce Well\-Architected principles and Success Cadence / Signature Success programs.
* Experience contributing to pre\-sales, SOW development, or proposal writing.

**Key Competencies**

**Competency**

**Description**

**Solution Architecture**

Ability to design scalable, secure, maintainable Salesforce solutions aligned to business outcomes.

**Client Advisory**

Comfortable operating as a trusted advisor across business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

**Technical Leadership**

Guides and mentors delivery teams, sets technical direction, and ensures quality standards.

**Problem Solving**

Diagnoses complex, ambiguous technical issues and drives them to resolution under managed services SLAs.

**Communication**

Translates technical complexity into business value; strong written and verbal communication.

**Commercial Awareness**

Understands managed services commercial models, scope management, and account growth opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Client platforms are stable, scalable, and continuously improved under the managed services engagement.
* Clients view the Technical Architect as a strategic, trusted advisor — not just a support resource.
* Solutions delivered are well\-architected, reusable, and reduce long\-term technical debt.
* Delivery teams are enabled and mentored to deliver high\-quality work independently.
* Managed services accounts grow in scope and value over time due to proactive technical guidance.

Pay: ₹908,679\.76 \- ₹2,451,732\.38 per year

Work Location: In person

29ad6e30.description:
**Job Description** 




 Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



*Level: Senior Program Management (12–15 years)* 




  





**Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery** 




**Location:** 
 Offshore (Hyderabad, India) – Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 12–15 years
 



**Scope:** 
 AWS, Distributed Systems Engineering, Data/BI \& Integration (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), Cloud DevOps, AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery across the engineering teams supporting our health plan technology platform, spanning software engineering (Junior through Architect levels, working in Go, Python, Node.js, and AWS\-based distributed systems), Data \& Integration Engineering (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), and DevOps \& Cloud Engineering (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS/OpenShift). This is a techno\-functional leadership role: you will own the program plan, translate customer and business requirements into clear technical direction, and track delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and onshore/offshore teams. Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end program and project delivery across engineering teams spanning software engineering, data/BI \& integration engineering, and DevOps/cloud engineering
* Partner directly with customer and business stakeholders to understand business priorities, constraints, and success criteria within the health insurance/payer domain
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical requirements, epics, and stories, ensuring shared understanding across product, architecture, and delivery teams
* Build, maintain, and track detailed program plans, schedules, dependencies, RAID logs, and status reporting across all workstreams
* Drive sprint/iteration planning, backlog grooming, and delivery governance (Agile/Scrum/Kanban) across distributed onshore/offshore teams
* Champion and drive an AI\-first engineering mindset across all teams, ensuring AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and operations practices are adopted consistently across every solution delivered
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce operational cost, and drive adoption plans together with engineering and architecture leads
* Manage cross\-team dependencies across software engineering, data/BI/integration, and DevOps/cloud engineering roles, proactively resolving blockers
* Own stakeholder communication: executive status updates, steering committee reporting, and risk/issue escalation
* Partner with architects on technical roadmap alignment with business priorities
* Ensure delivery quality, compliance, and security requirements, including HIPAA\-aware practices, are embedded into program execution
* Mentor and guide engineering leads on program management fundamentals and on driving AI\-first delivery within their teams



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification is a plus
* 12–15 years of experience in technical program or project management, including delivery of complex, multi\-team software engineering programs
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture concepts, sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade\-offs
* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines
* Strong command of program/project management tools and methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban, JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, or similar), including building and tracking project plans, RAID logs, and status reports
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer and business context and translate business requirements into actionable technical direction for engineering teams
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to track progress, surface risks early, and drive resolution across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders and clients
* Experience managing and coordinating distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, engineering, and executive audiences



**AI\-First Leadership (Required)** 



* A genuine AI\-first mindset: able to identify, champion, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted testing and documentation) across every team and every solution under their management
* Practical, hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), sufficient to credibly set expectations and coach teams on effective, responsible usage
* Able to define and track AI\-adoption goals and metrics across engineering teams (e.g., proportion of AI\-assisted work, cycle\-time improvement, quality impact) as part of program governance
* Understanding of responsible and compliant AI usage in a health\-insurance context, including data\-privacy safeguards such as never exposing PHI or sensitive member/client data to external AI tools, and the ability to enforce these standards across teams
* Able to evaluate where AI can be applied across the full solution lifecycle, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations, and build these expectations into program plans
* Comfortable partnering with architects and engineering leads to embed AI\-first practices into technical roadmaps and solution designs



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in the US health insurance or payer domain: claims, eligibility, enrollment, provider/member data, and HIPAA\-aware program delivery
* Experience managing programs supporting health plan clients in a consulting or professional services environment
* Familiarity with the specific technologies used by the teams under management: Go, Python, Node.js, AWS EKS/OpenShift, AWS Glue, Power BI, IBM Message Broker/ACE, and cloud DevOps toolchains (Terraform, CI/CD)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate)
* Experience establishing AI governance frameworks or an AI center\-of\-excellence function within an engineering organization

a51cbed3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
a51cbed3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 As a Sr Technical Program Manager, you will drive end\-to\-end program delivery, Agile transformation, and cross\-functional alignment across multiple teams and workstreams. This role requires strong execution leadership, deep SAFe expertise, and the ability to influence stakeholders while ensuring predictable, high\-quality delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale, complex product development initiatives.
   

  

 Act as Lead Technical Program Manager / Release Train Engineer (RTE), driving execution across multiple Agile teams and workstreams.
   

  

 Facilitate and govern SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, Inspect \& Adapt, retrospectives), ensuring alignment and delivery predictability.
   

  

 Implement and strengthen Scaled Agile (SAFe) and Agile best practices, driving consistency across teams.
   

  

 Drive program\-level planning, execution, and delivery across scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
   

  

 Establish and track program metrics and KPIs (e.g., velocity, predictability, defect trends) to drive continuous improvement.
   

  

 Provide leadership and mentorship to Scrum Masters and Agile teams, reinforcing Agile, Lean, and XP principles.
   

  

 Ensure effective cross\-team coordination, managing dependencies, risks, and impediments across distributed teams.
   

  

 Maintain and communicate a clear view of program goals, delivery progress, and risks to leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 Drive initiatives to improve quality, automation, and defect management practices across the program.
   

  

 Foster a high\-trust, collaborative team environment focused on transparency, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Support value stream planning, budgeting, and capacity management within a SAFe framework.
   

  

 Partner with business, product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.
   

  

 Identify and escalate program\-level risks and issues, driving timely resolution.
   

  

 Recommend process improvements, policy enhancements, and strategic initiatives to improve delivery efficiency.
   

  

**All About You**
 Strong experience as a Technical Program Manager / Release Train Engineer in a SAFe Agile environment.
   

  

 Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional programs involving multiple Agile teams.
   

  

 Deep understanding of SAFe principles, Agile methodologies, and Lean practices (certifications preferred).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience performing Scrum Master and Scrum of Scrums roles across complex programs.
   

  

 Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence, coach, and mentor teams without direct authority.
   

  

 Expertise in program metrics, reporting, and delivery governance.
   

  

 Strong understanding of project/program management fundamentals (scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk).
   

  

 Experience working with distributed teams, multiple stakeholders, and vendor partners.
   

  

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including leadership reporting.
   

  

 Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, process maturity, and organisational alignment.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills with a results\-oriented mindset.
   

  

 Ability to build a culture of accountability, transparency, and high performance.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
