611a1ff4.title: Presales Solution Architect, Quality Engineering (AI and GenAI)
611a1ff4.description:
Digital Engineering (DE\-QE) \| Hyderabad, India \| Work from office
   

  

 OSI Digital is seeking an experienced Presales Solution Consultant for its Quality Engineering practice. This person owns presales for QE and drives QE accelerators as a product line: turning customer testing problems into scoped, defensible solutions and commercial proposals, and building reusable QE assets that OSI can sell repeatedly.
   

  

 The role is customer facing and solution led, not a pure delivery seat. It suits someone with real QE delivery depth, strong research instincts, and genuine hands\-on AI and GenAI ability, who wants to shape and sell solutions while staying technically credible.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own presales for the QE practice: qualify opportunities, run discovery calls, and scope QE solutions covering test strategy, test automation, performance, and security testing.
* Build effort estimates, proposals, solution decks, and responses to RFP and RFI documents, and defend the assumptions with customer stakeholders.
* Prepare and run tailored demos and proofs of concept, including AI assisted testing demos.
* Position and sell OSI accelerators into QE opportunities, showing where each reduces testing effort, cost, or risk.
* Identify, design, and drive net\-new QE accelerators: reusable automation frameworks, AI assisted testing assets, and repeatable solution packages the practice can sell more than once.
* Own the go\-to\-market for QE accelerators: the pitch narrative, the demo, the reference architecture, and the packaging story.
* Design and demonstrate Gen AI assisted testing workflows: test case generation from requirements, test data synthesis, and automated test script drafting.
* Evaluate and honestly position AI features in testing tools, for example self\-healing locators, visual validation, and risk\-based test selection.
* Prototype LLM and retrieval\-based aids for QE, such as a knowledge assistant over test documentation or GenAI support for defect triage.
* Research the QE tooling and vendor landscape and each prospect before engagement, and separate real capability from vendor marketing.
* Bridge the sold solution and the delivery team and contribute hands\-on to early delivery on strategic accounts, so the approach is proven in practice.
* Support architecture and code reviews for QE automation and drive AI, GenAI adoption across the QE team.
* Produce solution documentation, reusable assets, and enablement material.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Core Experience
   

  

* 5 to 9 years of overall QA and QE experience, with at least 5 years hands\-on in test automation.
* 2 or more years of practical, hands\-on use of LLMs or GenAI in real work, not just awareness.
* Prior presales, solution consulting, or strong customer facing delivery exposure.


 QE and Automation Skills
   

  

* Strong with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and RestAssured.
* API and UI automation, regression, and in\-sprint testing.
* Test integration in CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based workflows.
* Performance testing (JMeter, k6, or NeoLoad) is an advantage.


 Presales and Accelerator Skills
   

  

* Scoping and estimating technical engagements and defending the assumptions.
* Building proposals and presenting confidently to customer stakeholders.
* Track record of building reusable frameworks or assets that can be productized, not just one\-off delivery.


 AI and GenAI Skills
   

  

* Practical use of LLMs in real work, with the ability to check and validate generated output.
* Prompt design and retrieval (RAG) at a working level.
* Python or scripting for AI prototypes.


 Cloud and Ecosystem
   

  

* Understand at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience with Containerized test environments is an advantage.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience taking an internal accelerator or product to market, including pricing or packaging.
* Exposure to enterprise ERP or regulated industry testing.
* Security testing.
* Experience with AI augmented testing tools and vector databases.


 We are not looking for someone who
   

  

* Is not willing to work from the office.
* Has never worked directly with customers or in a client facing role.
* Has only manual testing experience with no hands\-on automation.
* Treats AI and GenAI as buzzwords, with no real hands\-on usage.
* Wants a pure delivery seat with no presales, solutioning, or customer interaction.

90bc44b4.title: Manager, SW System & Solution Dev Engineer
90bc44b4.description:
**The Company**

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.  



We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.  



  

**Meet the Team:**

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Software Development Lead to spearhead the establishment and growth of our new R\&D Software design center in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. This role is crucial in setting up our software development and test operations, seeking out the best talent to join in our mission, and fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and collaboration.


In this role, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight, guiding the direction of our software product development and test automation initiatives. You will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of high\-quality solutions.


This position offers a unique opportunity to lead and shape the future of our R\&D reference arch and platform software efforts in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment. You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.


**Where you come in:**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a software engineering team delivering mobile and cloud software solutions supporting Dexcom products and services.
* Establish and communicate team priorities and execution plans aligned with product and organizational objectives.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing, Systems Engineering, and other stakeholders to define requirements, plan development activities, and ensure successful product delivery.
* Build and maintain a high\-performing engineering team focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and execution across assigned software initiatives.
* Ensure software development activities comply with applicable quality system requirements, medical device regulations, cybersecurity standards, and company policies.
* Drive software development best practices across mobile and cloud applications, including **iOS and Android development, cloud services, Agile methodologies, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development practices, and performance monitoring** **.**
* Provide technical guidance and contribute to software architecture and design decisions across mobile and cloud systems to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and product quality.
* Manage team staffing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee development, and resource planning activities.
* Use key performance indicators (KPIs), engineering metrics, and operational data to monitor team effectiveness, delivery performance, and product quality and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to manage interfaces and dependencies, share knowledge, improve development practices, and support successful end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Identify and manage technical, schedule, quality, security, and execution risks, escalating significant issues and tradeoffs when appropriate.
* Partner with Quality, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering functions to ensure software solutions meet functional, performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities, inspections, and regulatory submissions as required.
* Foster strong cross\-functional relationships and advocate for engineering quality, technical excellence, effective execution, and continuous improvement.

**What makes you successful:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of software development experience, including experience delivering complex software products.
* 3\+ years of people management experience leading software engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading, developing, and mentoring a software engineering team.
* **Strong experience with mobile and/or cloud application development, including iOS, Android, cloud services, or other connected software platforms.**
* Experience delivering software products through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, verification, release, and maintenance.
* Experience managing engineering priorities, schedules, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery commitments.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, software development methodologies, automated testing, and software quality practices.
* Ability to provide technical guidance and effectively evaluate software architecture, engineering decisions, technical risks, and tradeoffs.
* Understanding of distributed and connected software systems, including interactions and dependencies between mobile applications, cloud services, APIs, and other system components.
* Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders across Product, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience building and developing high\-performing engineering teams.
* Ability to balance technical quality, product requirements, regulatory requirements, resources, and delivery commitments.

**What you’ll get:**

* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community .
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
* An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

**Travel Required:**

* 15\-25%

**Experience and Education:**

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree with 10\+ years of industry experience.
* 7\+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry.

Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.*

  

**AI in Hiring Notice:** We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.  



  

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.  



Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com .

1d774383.title: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - India
1d774383.description:
**Company Overview**
 Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
   

  

****Company Operating Rhythm****
 At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
   

  

 Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
   

  

 Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\.
   

  

**Note: this role is based out of India and will service the APAC region.**
**Opportunity**
 Deepgram is expanding across APAC and operating a follow\-the\-sun model. We are hiring a Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineer in India to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. Our strategic Account Executives do not hand off their customers after the first sale, so you will partner long term across discovery, POC, production launch, and expansion. You will focus on pre\-sales, and you will often step into post\-sales style work when the stakes are high and continuity matters.
   

  

**About Applied Engineering At Deepgram**
 Applied Engineering blends what many companies split into Solutions Engineering, Architecture, Consulting, and Senior Technical Support. We are builders and communicators who bridge sales and engineering. We help customers move from problem to production with speed, clarity, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead technical discovery for strategic opportunities. Map business goals to measurable technical success criteria and an evaluation plan.
* Design, scope, and execute POCs that prove value. Define datasets, metrics, and timelines that land a clear technical win.
* Build lightweight prototypes, sample integrations, and demos using Deepgram SDKs and APIs.
* Advise on architecture for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. Cover cloud, self\-hosted, hybrid, and data residency needs.
* Run security and compliance threads common in APAC. Prepare crisp responses for Singapore PDPA, Japan APPI, Korea PIPA, Australia’s Privacy Act, and India’s DPDP Act.
* Triage and debug issues during evaluations. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to unblock customers quickly.
* Create reusable assets that scale. Turn repeated requests into working samples, reference architectures, runbooks, and field guides.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Support for seamless continuity after initial wins. Stay involved through expansion phases when needed.
* Enable the field. Collaborate with AEs, CSMs, and partners on positioning, demos, and technical validation for priority use cases.


**Regional Expectations**
* Based in an APAC time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours across East Asia, Southeast Asia, and ANZ.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Additional Asian languages are a strong plus, especially Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.
* Familiarity with procurement, InfoSec, and data privacy expectations across APAC.
* Ability to travel within the region for key customer milestones. Estimated travel 10 to 20 percent.


**Your First 90 Days**
**Ramp approach for this role** 
 Ramping mirrors the Solutions Architect plan, with explicit ticket work and earlier support for strategic Account Executives. In the first weeks you will pick up low\-risk customer tickets to learn our systems and support flow, then progress to pre\-sales escalations tied to active evaluations.
   

  

**First 30 days**
* Ramp on Deepgram’s product surface area, platform APIs, SDKs, evaluation methodology, and security review materials.
* Shadow strategic discovery and POC calls across APAC time zones.
* Triage and resolve low\-risk tickets with a Solutions Architect or Support partner. Focus on reproductions, log and trace collection, SDK setup issues, and clear notes and handoffs.
* Publish one internal field guide that clarifies a common APAC pre\-sales topic (for example data residency, telephony capture, or evaluation metrics).


**By day 60**
* Own two evaluations end to end with defined success criteria and timelines.
* Serve as the named technical partner for one or two strategic AEs. Run weekly technical deal reviews and prepare objection\-handling packs.
* Take point on higher\-signal tickets related to your evaluations, coordinating fast fixes with Product, Engineering, and Support.
* Deliver one live demo that becomes a reusable asset for the region. Pair with a Solutions Architect on a production launch to learn handoffs and escalation paths.


**By day 90**
* Act as the primary pre\-sales technical owner for several opportunities and expansions within strategic accounts.
* Close at least one complex technical win with a measurable impact on revenue.
* Lead one customer architecture workshop that documents a reference plan for production rollout or expansion.
* Convert repeated ticket patterns into a runbook, sample, or accelerator and present a short readout on the impact.


**You Will Thrive Here If You**
* Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands\-on building.
* Can move from whiteboard to working code and back without losing the thread.
* Communicate clearly with executives and deeply with engineers.
* Value speed with rigor and crisp documentation.
* Like winning together across regions and functions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5 or more years in Solutions Engineering or a similar customer\-facing technical role focused on pre\-sales.
* Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Rust. You can build POCs and tools that real users run.
* Hands\-on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, networking fundamentals, and secure API design.
* Proven track record leading POCs for enterprise customers and earning the technical win.
* Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with speech recognition, TTS, voice quality analysis, or AI agents that orchestrate LLMs.
* Familiarity with telephony and real\-time media concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, streaming, and WebSocket integrations.
* Experience with self\-hosted and hybrid deployments, including Helm\-based installs and production observability.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and data residency topics that appear in APAC enterprise reviews.
* Fluency in an additional Asian language such as Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.


**How We Work**
* Remote across APAC with periodic regional meetups.
* Close partnership with AEs, SAs, Product, and Engineering to support continuous coverage across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs.


**Interview Process**
* Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics.
* Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact.
* Practical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect discovery, solution design, and a short hands\-on exercise.
* Panel interviews with cross\-functional partners.
* Live demo and architecture walkthrough of a past technical win. Show your approach to success criteria, trade offs, and outcomes.


 If this sounds like you, we would love to meet you!
   

  

***Notice** 
 : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @* 
*deepgram.com* 
*email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

49b94770.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
49b94770.description:
Bangalore, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

As an Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer, you operate at the front line of delivery \- embedded with the client, turning ambiguous business problems into production agents, fast. Your deliverable is Business Transformation Agents: autonomous and multi\-agent systems that automate and reimagine real business processes such as invoice disputes, procurement approvals, onboarding, claims and compliance workflows. You own each agent end to end \-conceptualize, build, integrate, evaluate, deploy, and sustain \- and you lead a small team to do the same. You build exclusively in Python using agent development kits, and you bring Agentic AI capabilities to life inside the client's world, with Responsible AI, evaluation and security as non\-negotiables.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
**Conceptualize fast:** embed with stakeholders, frame a business process as an agentic solution, and stand up a working agent prototype in days, not weeks.
  
**Build Business Transformation Agents:** design and ship single\-agent and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs that automate and transform real client workflows, with measurable ROI.
  
**Own efficiency as the scorecard:** drive delivery efficiency and operational efficiency ; shorter cycle times, less manual effort, higher accuracy, lower cost\-to\-serve.
  
**Engineer the agent core:** apply prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration.
  
**Integrate to standards:** connect agents into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication.
  
**Make reusability and predictability the default:** build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates; add guardrails so agent behaviour is predictable, safe and repeatable.
  
**Prototype and iterate quickly:** use the kit's scaffolding to prototype, then harden to production\-grade, well\-tested Python.
  
**Run eval\-driven development:** build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure agent correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.
  
**Own AgentOps / DevSecOps:** CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability and telemetry, shift\-left security, and Responsible AI governance baked in from day one.
  
**Run a continuous, adaptable feedback loop:** feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design.
  
**Stay ahead of the curve:** adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
  
**Lead and mentor:** set technical direction for a lean team of 3 agent engineers, raise the engineering bar, and grow the pod's agentic capability.
  
What you'll bring (must\-have)
  
Strong Python engineering ; idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code; on a foundation of solid software engineering principles (design, version control, architecture).
  
Hands\-on agent building with at least one agent development kit (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel).
  
**Solid command of agent engineering:** prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP, and multi\-agent orchestration.
  
**Eval\-driven development:** designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability.
  
**Standards\-based integration and DevSecOps:** APIs, secure auth, CI/CD, observability and AgentOps.
  
Ability to conceptualize a business problem as an agent quickly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, customer\-embedded settings.
  
**Client\-facing maturity:** translates fluidly between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and owns outcomes.
  
Experience mentoring or leading small engineering teams.
  
What great looks like (strongly preferred)
  
Fluency across multiple ADKs and the judgment to pick the right one per engagement.
  
Deploying agents to managed runtimes at enterprise scale (e.g. Vertex AI Agent Engine, Bedrock AgentCore) with governance and cost control.
  
Domain depth in a transformation area \- finance operations, supply chain, HR, claims or compliance.
  
Experience with an enterprise agent platform, including Responsible AI and governance at scale.
  
A track record of turning agents into reusable accelerators or IP adopted beyond a single engagement.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

**Language:** Python preferable
  
  

**Frameworks:** Agent Development Kits (ADKs) ; e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same.
  
  

**Models:** Multi\-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost.
  
  

**Interfaces:** Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards\-based APIs and secure auth for client systems.
  
  

Other Requirements

**Frameworks:** Agent Development Kits (ADKs) ; e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same.

**The Opportunity:**

**Description**

These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform

* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

1b456576.title: Azure Platform SME — Solutioning & Pre-Sales
1b456576.description:
Job Description
  
**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Cloud \& Infrastructure practice is looking for an Azure Platform SME who can sit in front of a customer, understand their landscape, ask the right questions and shape the solution — then design and build it. This is a pre\-sales\-led role with real technical depth: the same person runs the discovery conversation, proposes the architecture, prepares the estimate and proposal, and stays hands\-on enough to design and provision the environment.


We are looking for someone whose strength is consultative rather than order\-taking. Much of the value in this role comes before any design is written — in asking the questions that surface the customer’s constraints, dependencies and real drivers, and in proposing an approach that fits their landscape rather than a standard template.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead customer discovery discussions and workshops — understand the current landscape across on\-premises and cloud estate, applications, infrastructure, network, identity, security, operations and existing commitments.
* Ask structured, probing questions to surface business drivers, constraints, dependencies, compliance requirements, timelines and success criteria — and identify what the customer has not said as much as what they have.
* Translate discovery findings into a proposed Azure solution — target architecture, options with clear trade\-offs (cost, risk, effort, timeline), phasing and a recommended approach.
* Present and defend the proposed solution to customer stakeholders, from technical teams through to IT and business leadership, and adapt the pitch to the audience in the room.
* Prepare proposals and pre\-sales collateral end to end — solution write\-ups, architecture diagrams, bill of materials, assumptions, dependencies, risks, scope boundaries and SOW inputs.
* Own effort and cost estimation — Azure consumption sizing and pricing, resource\-level estimates, licensing considerations, and services effort estimates with clear assumptions behind the numbers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and customer questionnaires, working with sales, delivery and practice leadership to build a coherent and competitive response.
* Design Azure platform architecture: subscription and environment strategy, landing zone, networking and connectivity, identity, security baselines, governance, monitoring, backup and DR.
* Provision, configure and validate Azure resources hands\-on — building POCs, pilots and initial environments to prove the solution and de\-risk delivery.
* Shape migration approaches for customer workloads — assessment, sizing, wave planning, migration method and cutover considerations.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery teams and remain available as design authority — design reviews, escalation support and architecture governance through the engagement.
* Build reusable pre\-sales assets: reference architectures, solution templates, estimation models, proposal boilerplate and discovery question sets that shorten future pursuits.
* Engage Microsoft and partner stakeholders on joint pursuits, funding programmes and co\-sell motions where applicable.
* Mentor junior architects and pre\-sales consultants, and raise the quality bar on solution and proposal work across the practice.

  
Qualification
  
**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 8–11 years of overall experience in cloud solution architecture, infrastructure or cloud pre\-sales, with a strong recent focus on Microsoft Azure.
* Solid Azure platform knowledge across the core stack: compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and the platform services commonly used by enterprise workloads.
* Proven customer\-facing solutioning experience — running discovery discussions and workshops, understanding a customer landscape quickly, and proposing an appropriate solution rather than a generic one.
* Strong questioning and listening skills, with the judgement to challenge assumptions constructively and to identify gaps, risks and dependencies early.
* Hands\-on experience designing and provisioning Azure resources — able to build and configure environments personally, not only produce diagrams.
* Demonstrated pre\-sales track record : proposals, solution write\-ups, bill of materials, RFP/RFI responses and client\-facing presentations.
* Strong estimation capability — Azure sizing and cost estimation, effort estimation for services, and the discipline to document assumptions, exclusions and risks clearly.
* Experience designing Azure landing zones and migration approaches for enterprise customers.
* Azure networking depth: hub\-and\-spoke topologies, ExpressRoute and VPN, NSGs/UDRs, firewalling and routing, Private Link and DNS design.
* Working knowledge of Azure identity and security: Entra ID and hybrid identity, RBAC, conditional access, Key Vault and Defender for Cloud.
* Ability to produce clear, well\-structured architecture and proposal documentation (HLD, solution overview, migration plan) at client\-ready quality.
* Scripting capability in PowerShell and/or CLI for provisioning, configuration and operational tasks.
* Confident communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to hold a room of senior customer stakeholders.
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Infrastructure as Code experience — Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates — and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Good to have, not essential; willingness to build this depth is expected.
* Microsoft certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), Azure Network Engineer (AZ\-700\), or security certifications such as SC\-100 / SC\-200\.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Intune/ EMS and endpoint management as part of an integrated customer estate.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes — partner capability alignment, specialization readiness, Microsoft field engagement or distributor GTM.
* AWS or GCP exposure for multi\-cloud positioning and comparative solutioning.
* Familiarity with Azure AI and data services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric) and how those workloads land on a governed platform.
* FinOps awareness — cost optimisation , right\-sizing and ongoing consumption management.
* Experience in regulated or compliance\-heavy environments (BFSI, healthcare, energy, public sector), including data residency requirements.
* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment working with distributed teams.
* Prior contribution to reusable accelerators, reference architectures or practice\-building initiatives.

* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.

**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps organizations seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way.  As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will operate at the pinnacle of technical leadership, ensuring strategic global customers have a transformative experience adopting Gemini Enterprise and the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite. You will design, govern, and oversee the implementation of highly resilient, production\-ready application architectures. You will partner with executive stakeholders to identify monumental opportunities for enterprise\-wide workflow transformation using autonomous agents. With unparalleled access to Google’s technology, you will handle the most complex performance and behavioral agent challenges, ultimately leading the end\-to\-end execution of global Google Cloud digital transformations.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead as Forward Deployed Agentic Engineer that will drive the Agentic AI products across the Chief Operating Office, acting as the bridge between product development, operations, and AI engineering. The role focuses on embedding LLM\-powered, Agentic workflows directly into enterprise processes, enabling measurable business outcomes, operational transformation, and scalable AI adoption.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence digital products, initiatives, plans, specifications, resources, and long\-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across a functional area within the Digital environment
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
* Deliver solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Coordinate highly complex activities and guidance to others
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have significant impact
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise
* Serve as an expert advisor to leadership

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* **1\) Forward Deployment of Agentic AI Products ·**
* Lead end\-to\-end deployment of agentic AI solutions into live banking operations
* Embed AI agents directly into operational workflows for automation and decision support.
* Work closely with business and operations teams to move from concept to production.
* Ensure enterprise\-grade deployment, scalability, and governance of AI solutions.
* **2\) Discovery, Process Intelligence \& Value Realization ·**
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and operations stakeholders. ·
* Analyze process artifacts (SOPs, runbooks, workflows, video recordings, process mining outputs, etc.) to identify AI and automation opportunities.
* Translate operational processes into agentic workflows and solution blueprints. ·
* Define KPIs and quantify business benefits (cost reduction, cycle time, risk mitigation, productivity gains). ·
* Build ROI models and value realization frameworks for AI initiatives.
* **3\) Agentic Solution Design, MCP Tools \& Workflow Orchestration ·**
* Design and implement agentic AI solutions using process artifacts as input for workflow automation. ·
* Develop multi\-step AI agents capable of reasoning, tool use, and task execution. ·
* Leverage MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources. ·
* Enable tool\-augmented LLM workflows including function calling, orchestration, and structured outputs. ·

a994ef6a.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Proven track record of managing portfolio planning and roadmap prioritization, ensuring alignment between engineering, product, and executive North Star metrics.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools and frameworks to automate workflows, enhance data\-driven decision\-making, and accelerate program execution.
* Ability to apply technical judgment to navigate engineering scope, assess feasibility, and manage dependencies across a global stack.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices \& Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices \& Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and coordinate projects that span offices, product areas, and time zones, ensuring all players are aligned on progress and deadlines.
* Maintain flexibility to collaborate across global time zones, which includes participating in evening meetings to sync with international stakeholders and cross\-site partners.
* Partner with engineering and product leads to accelerate organizational execution and drive high\-priority initiatives.
* Manage the organization’s portfolio planning and prioritization, drive roadmap/OKR planning, milestones, and software schedules in partnership with product and engineering.
* Advocate the use of AI best practices and tools to automate workflows, reduce manual toil, and improve overall program efficiency.

1f44af0e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
1f44af0e.description:
**Netradyne** 
 harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern\-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
   

  

**Role : Sr. Technical Program Manager (Product Development)**
**Experience : 10 to 15 years**
**Summary:**
 As a Technical Program Manager / Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will own electronic product development programs end\-to\-end — from ideation and concept definition through prototyping, design, validation, commercialization / industrialization, and final delivery. You will orchestrate cross\-functional teams spanning hardware, software / firmware, mechanical, quality, operations, sourcing and product management, alongside external partners such as ODMs, contract manufacturers and component suppliers. You will be accountable for the program plan, schedule, budget, risks and overall execution, ensuring the right product is delivered at the right cost, quality and time. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating both rapid Agile software cycles and structured hardware stage\-gate development, remaining flexible and calm in the face of uncertainty.
   

  

**Responsibilities \-**
* Own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle of electronic products from ideation to delivery, integrating hardware, software / firmware, mechanical and industrial design workstreams into a single executable plan.
* Drive disciplined stage\-gate execution across concept, prototyping, EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production, ensuring entry / exit criteria are met at each phase.
* Create and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, dependency maps and risk registers; surface critical path and proactively remove impediments.
* Plan and manage prototyping and bring\-up cycles, coordinating board bring\-up, integration, debug and iteration loops between hardware and firmware teams.
* Drive design and manufacturability reviews (DFM / DFA / DFT), BOM maturity, design\-for\-cost and design\-for\-reliability discussions with engineering and suppliers.
* Lead commercialization / industrialization activities — NPI ramp, manufacturing line setup and transfer, tooling, first\-article and yield improvement at the contract manufacturer.
* Coordinate certification and regulatory compliance (EMC, safety, ingress and applicable automotive / regional standards) within the program timeline.
* Partner with sourcing and operations on component qualification, supplier readiness, lead times and supply continuity.
* Manage cost, schedule and scope; track program health, costs and roadmaps through clear, communicable dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.
* Run Agile / Scrum for software and firmware deliverables, Kanban for recurring activities, and milestone\-based tracking for hardware; flex the model to fit each workstream.
* Communicate status, risks and trade\-offs to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders; build consensus and enable visibility across the organization.
* Plan achievable goals working with vendor / partner PMs and internal cross\-functional teams; make timely corrections and alternative plans to keep final deliverables on time.


**Requirements And Skills \-**
* Proven experience program managing electronic / electro\-mechanical product development end\-to\-end, from ideation through to delivery.
* Hands\-on exposure across the full stack — hardware, embedded software / firmware and mechanical — with the ability to converse credibly with each function.
* Demonstrated experience taking products through prototyping and into commercialization / industrialization and mass production.
* Strong program planning, risk management and cross\-functional leadership skills, with experience managing external manufacturing and supplier partners.
* Comfortable operating in both Agile development and structured hardware stage\-gate (EVT / DVT / PVT) environments.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* B.E / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Computer Science Engineering.
* MBA is a plus.
* TPM: 8\+ years of Technical Program Management experience in an electronic product development scenario; Sr. TPM: 12\+ years, including ownership of full product programs.
* Hands\-on experience across SDLC and hardware product development (EVT / DVT / PVT), with successful delivery of commercial high\-tech electronic products from ideation to market.
* Experience in commercializing / industrializing new hardware products and managing the transfer to contract manufacturing.
* Familiarity with integrating edge devices with cloud platforms is advantageous.
* Proficient in MS Project, JIRA, Confluence, Tableau, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SQL.
* PMP / ITIL certification is a plus.
* Hands\-on Agile experience or Scrum certification is a plus.
* Motivation to be self\-driven and not afraid to get hands dirty.


 We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.
   

  

 If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.
   

  

 Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer.
   

  

**Applicants only \- Recruiting agencies do not contact.**
**Recruitment Fraud Alert!**
 There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set\-up and does not use recruitment or job\-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@netradyne.com’ or ‘@us\-greenhouse\-mail.io’.
   

  

 Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne.com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website.

1f32bcf5.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
1f32bcf5.description:
****Job Summary** 
 :** 
 Job Summary: As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will lead media programs, influencing the teams' roadmap priorities and technical direction. This role combines strong technical understanding, program leadership, and agile delivery excellence. You will own end\-to\-end execution of critical programs, influence roadmap direction, manage cross\-team dependencies and senior stakeholders, and mentor teams to raise execution maturity across the organization.
   

  

****About the Team:****
 Content Commerce is a new and high\-impact initiative at the intersection of content, advertising and commerce. The vision is to make content shoppable. Users should be able to discover products naturally while watching shows, movies, sports, or short\-form content \- and move from inspiration to purchase with minimal friction. This team will build the platform that powers commerce experiences across JioHotstar content surfaces. That includes product discovery, contextual recommendations, shoppable placements, brand integrations, storefront experiences, measurement, and partner integrations with commerce platforms.
   

  

****Key responsibilities****
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration
* Lead large, complex technical programs from planning through delivery independently
* Influence roadmap priorities by aligning stakeholders on objectives and outcomes
* Coordinate across engineering, product, and business teams to manage dependencies and ensure timely execution
* Facilitate cross\-pod collaboration and alignment to maintain delivery momentum
* Proactively plan for and mitigate risks, evaluating alternatives, quantifying trade\-offs, and structuring communication plans
* Apply Agile methodologies for iterative delivery, adaptive planning, and continuous improvement
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and foster high Scrum maturity
* Maintain sprint cadence and rigor through reviews, retrospectives, and OKR alignment
* Drive pod\-level accountability for JIRA hygiene, analytics reporting, and milestone tracking
* Ensure data\-driven decision\-making using clear metrics, dashboards, and visual progress reporting
* Regularly communicate program updates, decisions, and risks to leadership concisely and visually
* Continuously improve internal processes to enhance team efficiency and delivery velocity
* Act as a mentor for junior TPMs and team members to scale program management maturity


****Skills and attributes for success:****
* Deep technical understanding of scalable systems, with the ability to dive into architecture reviews, ask second\-order questions, and push for scalable, resilient solutions
* Highly structured thinker with the ability to break down ambiguous goals into executable plans, identify blind spots, and push for clarity in both direction and detail
* Strong grasp of risk/reward tradeoffs, and comfort operating in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments with shifting priorities and evolving context
* Exceptional communicator, skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and aligning diverse teams on shared timelines, goals, and impact
* Strong program management experience managing cross functional initiatives end to end and driving influence without authority
* Strong experience leading complex cross\-functional programs involving AI/ML and GenAI systems at scale.
* Should have deep technical understanding of AI platforms, execution rigor, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive AI initiatives from strategy to production.
* Experience with LLMs, AI infrastructure, model lifecycle management, and scalable delivery processes is highly preferred.
* Expertise in Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe) and tools like JIRA, Confluence


****Preferred education and experience:****
* A Bachelor's/Master’s degree with a minimum of 8\-10 years of experience, including 3 to 4 years in a Program Management role within the consumer technology sector


**About JioStar**
 Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.
   

  

*JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.*
